news.Title: Microsoft's latest outage hit Outlook and Copilot — what it means for your email
news.Content: Millions of office workers got an unplanned break from email Thursday. Their bosses' favorite new AI tool got one too. A Microsoft ( MSFT ) outage that began midday Thursday knocked out Outlook and other workplace apps worldwide, with Downdetector logging reports from 74 countries within about an hour. By Friday, Microsoft said it was seeing "encouraging recovery progress." The damage reached Microsoft's AI. Copilot couldn't access users' email, files, or calendars, and the Microsoft connectors for OpenAI's ChatGPT and Anthropic's ( ANTH.PVT ) Claude broke too. Microsoft says more than 430 million people use its Microsoft 365 apps. What it means for you Your email isn't lost. Microsoft stretched its email timeout to 48 hours , so messages sent to you keep trying to deliver instead of bouncing back. There isn't much to fix on your end. Resetting your password or reinstalling Outlook won't help, though desktop Outlook may still show mail it already downloaded. If your company pays for Microsoft 365, it may be owed money. Microsoft promises 99.9% uptime , about 43 minutes of downtime a month, with credits of 25% to 100% of the monthly fee when it falls short. Your IT department has to file the claim. Not the first time Microsoft is hard to replace, which is usually good news for its shareholders. Pershing Square CEO Bill Ackman, whose fund owns Microsoft stock, said at Yahoo Finance Invest on Thursday that Microsoft is "the gateway to how people interact with the basic workflows of a desk worker," which makes it "a much more difficult position to dislodge." This week showed the other side of that. Microsoft has blamed its own changes or maintenance for Microsoft 365 disruptions in at least six months this year, from a nearly 10-hour outage in January to a spam-filter update that bounced real email earlier this month. Australia's home affairs minister, Tony Burke, said Microsoft believes it's dealing with "an update that has gone awry," much like the 2024 CrowdStrike meltdown. Have you tried turning it off and on again? Microsoft reached for the oldest fix in the help desk manual, saying Thursday it was "restarting affected servers to return them to service." It didn't stick. Servers that came back went down again once traffic returned, and on Friday Microsoft was reversing a recent network change without confirming it was the cause. What we know about the layoffs The outage comes as Microsoft trims its workforce while spending heavily on AI. It offered buyouts to about 60,000 employees in October, and those who accept leave Dec. 31. CEO Satya Nadella said last year that AI writes "maybe 20%, 30%" of Microsoft's code . Story Continues There's no evidence either played a role. In a statement to Yahoo Finance, Charles Lamanna, Microsoft's executive vice president for Copilot, Agents and Platform, said the company regrets "the impact these outages had on those who depend on us" and that "our teams are reviewing what happened and how we can prevent similar issues going forward." He didn't address questions about staffing or AI tools. Chris Versace, chief investment officer at Tematica Research, put the lesson simply: "The outage and how it hobbled many businesses and other enterprises is a reminder about the need for redundancies." Internal AI tools helped analyze interview transcripts, research, and draft this post. Humans reviewed, edited, and fact-checked this post before publication. Jared Blikre is the global markets and data editor for Yahoo Finance. Follow him on X at @SPYJared or email him at jaredblikre@yahooinc.com . news.Title: HSBC Says Buy the Dip in These 11 Stocks -- Alphabet and Oracle Top the List
news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

HSBC has identified 11 stocks it considers attractive buying opportunities following a broad market pullback, with recommendations spanning technology, industrials, energy and financial services, according to a Thursday research note.

The bank's latest selections include Alphabet ( NASDAQ:GOOGL ), Applied Materials (AMAT), Baker Hughes (BKR), Bloom Energy ( NYSE:BE ) and Citigroup (C). The list also features Freeport-McMoRan ( NYSE:FCX ), GE Vernova ( NYSE:GEV ), NextEra Energy ( NYSE:NEE ), Oracle ( NYSE:ORCL ), Sempra (SRE) and Vertiv (VRT).

Is FCX fairly valued? Test your thesis with our free DCF calculator.

The recommendations follow a rotation that has weighed on technology and industrial shares. Both sectors have lost about 8% to 9% over the past three months, while certain industry groups have retreated nearly 20% from recent highs. HSBC views parts of the decline as excessive relative to underlying business conditions.

The bank sees potential support from artificial intelligence infrastructure spending, electricity demand, semiconductor investment and improving financial performance. Alphabet and Oracle offer exposure to AI-related cloud growth, while Applied Materials benefits from chipmaking investment. Energy and power companies could gain from rising electricity consumption and data center expansion.

news.Title: Cerebras Stocks Jump 11.70% After Raising Outlook and Confirming Microsoft Cloud Deal
news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

Cerebras Systems ( NASDAQ:CBRS ) shares jumped 11.70% to $109.19 as of 9:53 a.m. ET in Friday's regular session on November 13, after CEO Andrew Feldman confirmed a cloud computing agreement with Microsoft on Thursday's earnings call. Terms were not disclosed, and the company plans to share more next year.

Warning! GuruFocus has detected 3 Warning Signs with CBRS.

Is CBRS fairly valued? Test your thesis with our free DCF calculator.

The quarter showed a business turning into a cloud provider. GAAP revenue rose 55% to $210.8 million, and core revenue grew 70% to $230.9 million. Cloud and other services made up about 67% of GAAP revenue, with GAAP cloud revenue up 265%. Remaining performance obligations reached $26.1 billion. Core gross margin improved to 41.0%, though the GAAP net loss was $161.2 million. Cerebras raised 2026 core revenue guidance to $940 million to $960 million from $880 million to $890 million, guided fourth-quarter core revenue to $310 million to $330 million, and reiterated that revenue should triple in 2027.

The fourth-quarter midpoint implies a 38.6% jump from third-quarter core revenue, a steep ramp that depends on capacity coming online on time. The backlog equals about 27 times this year's revenue guide, so delivery, not demand, is the constraint. The shares also remain well below the $185 IPO price from May. The GuruFocus chart shows a GF Score of 19/100, a weak reading driven by low profitability and a short track record, even though the balance sheet scores reasonably well after the IPO. Investors are buying the backlog, not the current financials. The next test is whether fourth-quarter core revenue lands inside the $310 million to $330 million range.

news.Title: 台股ETF前10排名洗牌　它首次擠進前10！
news.Content: 根據集保所最新統計，台股ETF受益人前十大排名發生變化，有一檔首度躍升百萬人次俱樂部、有一檔則是「回鍋」百萬受益人行列，更有一檔擠下老牌ETF，首次突圍排名前十。儘管歷經外資10月中下旬的賣超，台股重跌逾千點，本土資金仍持續看好台股後市發展、持續逢低買進，台股ETF近一周受益人普遍呈現正成長。 觀察最新台股ETF受益人排名，元大台灣50(0050)持續站穩第一寶座，而今年2月才上市的凱基台灣TOP50(009816)氣勢如虹，受益人首度突破百萬人次、目前排名第五，主動統一台股增長(00981A)也繼今年7月後，受益人次再次回到百萬以上，排名第六。此外，主動中信台灣收益(00406A)則次首次入榜，取代富邦科技(0052)，成為目前台股ETF受益人次排名第十。 隨著各投信持續發行不同類型ETF，投資人的選擇也逐漸多元，市場競爭也隨之激烈。目前台股ETF受益人次前十就有三檔是今年才掛牌上市，可見投資人的喜好如浮雲，老牌ETF儘管有名氣，倘若績效表現不如投資人預期，資金亦可能隨時撤離。 今年以來受益人次成長最多的台股ETF，除了元大台灣50(0050)，就是凱基台灣TOP50(009816)，發行短短9個月的時間，受益人就衝破百萬，可見投資人對不配息產品的肯定。凱基台灣TOP50(009816)ETF研究團隊表示，面對指數快速修正與外資賣壓升溫之際，建議投資人區辨修正的性質，若基本面未見轉向，回檔屬換股與擇優加碼的時機；後續雲端業者削減投資或出口動能轉弱，才是降低持股的訊號；此外，以財報汰弱留強，第3季財報將檢驗調價邏輯能否轉化為毛利率，交得出數字者續抱，評價跑在獲利前面者則利用反彈調節。

news.Title: Automotive Properties Real Est Invt TR Q3 Earnings Call Highlights
news.Content:
Key Points

Interested in Automotive Properties Real Est Invt TR? Here are five stocks we like better.

Third-quarter operating results improved: Rental revenue rose to $30.5 million from $24.4 million, while AFFO increased 15.8% and diluted AFFO per unit climbed to $0.26 from $0.252.

The REIT sold half of its Vaughan dealership property for CAD 16 million, recording a CAD 6.5 million gain, and later acquired a Tesla-leased property in North Carolina for about $30 million.

Management said it has roughly CAD 50 million to CAD 75 million of current acquisition capacity and will pursue selective deals that diversify tenants and markets while supporting per-unit AFFO growth.

Automotive Properties Real Est Invt TR (TSE:APR.UN) reported higher third-quarter rental revenue and adjusted funds from operations, as acquisitions and contractual rent increases supported growth. Management also outlined plans to expand in Canada and the United States while remaining selective about purchases.

President and CEO Milton Lamb said property acquisitions completed over the past year, along with fixed and inflation-adjusted rent increases, contributed to the quarter's performance. Diluted adjusted funds from operations, or AFFO, rose to $0.26 per unit from $0.252 a year earlier.

→ 3 Stocks Wall Street Likes More Than the Market Does

The REIT's AFFO payout ratio fell to 80% from 81%, even after two distribution increases since the previous September and a CAD 57 million equity offering in October 2025, Lamb said.

Rental revenue and cash flow rise

Property rental revenue increased to $30.5 million from $24.4 million in the year-earlier quarter, CFO Andrew Kalra said. Total cash net operating income rose 18.6% to $24.9 million, while same-property cash net operating income increased 2.3% to $21.3 million.

→ D-Wave Quantum Has Long-Term Potential, But Is Now the Time to Buy?

Funds from operations, or FFO, increased 16.8%, and AFFO rose 15.8%. Diluted FFO per unit increased to $0.266 from $0.255. Quarterly distributions totaled $0.208 per unit, compared with $0.204 a year earlier.

Interest expense and other financing charges rose by $1.8 million to $8.3 million, reflecting additional debt used to fund acquisitions. General and administrative expenses were $1.8 million, up approximately $90,000.

→ Archer Aviation's FAA Certificate Is a Milestone, But It Isn't the Final One

Net income and other comprehensive income increased to $35 million from $10.4 million. Kalra attributed the increase primarily to higher net operating income and fair value adjustments on investment properties and interest rate swaps, partly offset by higher interest costs.

Story Continues

Vaughan sale and North Carolina acquisition

During the quarter, the REIT sold a 50% interest in its dealership property on Jane Street in Vaughan to a member of the Dilawri Group for CAD 16 million, recording a CAD 6.5 million gain. The REIT retained the other half.

The property is now leased to a Dilawri affiliate as a full-service Kia dealership under a 16-year triple-net lease, with a landlord redevelopment option. Lamb said the new lease and recent renewals mean the REIT has no material lease expirations until 2028.

In response to an analyst's question, Lamb said the lease included three months of free rent from closing. The landlords split a CAD 3 million tenant inducement, with the REIT responsible for CAD 1.5 million. Kalra said the reported gain incorporates those amounts.

After quarter-end, the REIT acquired a Tesla-tenanted property in the greater Greensboro area of North Carolina for approximately $30 million. The roughly 50,000-square-foot sales, service and delivery center sits on about six acres and is subject to a long-term net lease with fixed annual rent increases and renewal options. Lamb said the purchase, funded primarily through revolving credit facilities, was the REIT's eighth Tesla-tenanted property.

Financing and acquisition outlook

At quarter-end, 76% of the REIT's debt was fixed, with a weighted average interest rate of 4.49%, Kalra said. During the quarter, it entered into $30 million of floating-to-fixed interest rate swaps and extended the maturity of one credit facility to March 2030 from March 2028. After quarter-end, it entered into a further CAD 20 million of swaps.

As of Nov. 12, the REIT had a debt-to-gross-book-value ratio of approximately 47.1%, CAD 43.5 million of undrawn revolving credit capacity and 12 unencumbered properties valued at CAD 197 million, Kalra said.

Asked about funding U.S. acquisitions, Kalra said the REIT had sufficient capacity under its Canadian credit facilities and could include U.S. properties in the financing pool. He said a move to U.S. credit facilities would come as the property base grows. A U.S. facility would currently carry an interest rate at least 100 basis points higher than a Canadian one, he estimated.

Lamb said acquisition yields appeared broadly consistent across Canada and the U.S., but the U.S. offered more markets and activity. He said some capitalization rates on new deals could be about 25 basis points higher than two or three months earlier, depending on sellers' responses to changing interest costs.

Lamb declined to provide an acquisition target for 2027, saying the REIT probably had CAD 50 million to CAD 75 million of capacity at present. He said management would remain selective, seeking properties that add tenant and geographic diversification while supporting AFFO per-unit growth.

About Automotive Properties Real Est Invt TR (TSE:APR.UN)

Automotive Properties REIT is an unincorporated, open-ended real estate investment trust focused on owning and acquiring primarily income-producing automotive and other OEM dealership and service properties located in Canada and the United States. The REIT's portfolio currently consists of 91 income-producing commercial properties, representing approximately 3.4 million square feet of gross leasable area, in metropolitan markets across British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario and Québec in Canada, and Florida and Ohio in the United States.

news.Title: Alphabet Stocks Rise 1.19% as Gemini 4 Hydrogen and $395 AI Glasses Launch
news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

Alphabet ( NASDAQ:GOOGL ) shares rose 1.19% to $302.26 as of 9:55 a.m. ET in Friday's regular session on November 13, a day after Google launched Gemini 4 Hydrogen as its new everyday AI model. On the same day, Google opened preorders for Gemini-powered glasses built with Samsung, Warby Parker and Gentle Monster.

Warning! GuruFocus has detected 5 Warning Signs with NU.

Is GOOGL fairly valued? Test your thesis with our free DCF calculator.

Google says Hydrogen finishes tasks about 2.5 times faster than Gemini 3.8 Flash and more than triples its Terminal-Bench 4.1 score, to 57% from 18.2%. It costs $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens, flat across a 1 million-token window. It is live in the Gemini API, the Gemini app and Google Search. The glasses start at $395 for Warby Parker frames and $449 for Gentle Monster, ship December 10 and run about nine hours on a charge. They carry a 12-megapixel camera and offer real-time translation in more than 70 languages.

The real story is cost. A faster, cheaper default model lowers Google's serving bill per query just as Search moves to AI answers, and that protects margins. The glasses add a new surface for Gemini but will stay a small revenue line for years. The GuruFocus chart shows a GF Score of 97/100, with elite profitability, a strong balance sheet and solid momentum. GF Value is $275.32, so the shares trade 9.8% above GuruFocus's estimate with a "Fairly Valued" label. Quality is largely priced in, so the upside has to come from execution. The next test is developer uptake of Hydrogen and holiday preorder demand for the glasses.

news.Title: 輝達恐寫14年最長連跌！一周市值蒸發6572億美元 下周財報能止血？
news.Content:
輝達(NVDA-US)股價持續承壓，本周迄今下跌14.4%，恐連續第六周收黑，寫下14年來最長周線連跌紀錄，單周市值已蒸發約6,572億美元。隨著公司下周二公布財報，市場除了關注業績，也將檢視庫藏股動作、執行長接班安排，以及與台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)等關鍵合作夥伴的關係能否維持穩定。

據《MarketWatch》報導，輝達面臨的賣壓早於黃仁勳醜聞曝光。市場對AI支出能否持續、新興雲端業者財務狀況，以及政治環境可能拖慢資料中心建設的疑慮，都讓股價承壓。黃仁勳因婚外情爭議突然辭任，又為公司前景增添不確定性。

費半上漲輝達卻重挫 財報與庫藏股成止跌觀察點

根據道瓊市場數據，若輝達本周收低，將追平2012年10月結束的六周連跌紀錄。本周市值縮水規模，也可能創下公司史上最大單周紀錄。

相較之下，費城半導體指數本周上漲5.6%，輝達落後約20個百分點，為2008年以來最大差距，顯示其本周表現明顯弱於整體晶片族群。

下一項考驗是下周二公布的截至10月季度財報。擔任財務長逾十年的克瑞斯(Colette Kress)，目前暫代執行長，市場將關注她如何說明公司營運與後續方向。

分析師也在觀察，輝達是否會透過大規模買回股票支撐股價。截至9月底，公司尚有2,350億美元的股票回購授權額度。不過，授權額度不代表已承諾投入，實際買回規模與速度仍待管理層說明。

接班不只換執行長 台積電合作與人才留任受矚目

TD Cowen分析師Joshua Buchalter領軍的團隊指出，黃仁勳離職留下的空缺，並非僅靠財務領導即可填補。除了克瑞斯，公司還需要具有明確技術與營運權威的領導者，未來可能形成不同於一般企業的領導架構。

分析師認為，接班人選將決定輝達未來方向，可能類似蘋果(AAPL-US)從重視願景的賈伯斯，交棒給更擅長營運管理的庫克。

對台灣投資人而言，重要觀察點是輝達與客戶、供應商的關係，尤其是台積電。TD Cowen指出，若出現客戶或供應商轉向其他合作對象，將是局勢尚未穩定的明確訊號；但這是分析師提出的風險指標，並非已有合作生變的消息。

此外，輝達對AI產業的投資布局是否調整，以及誰能接替黃仁勳成為AI發展最具影響力的倡議者，也存在疑問。分析師表示，目前尚不清楚相關投資有多少可能需要撤回。

在AI人才競爭激烈之際，輝達能否留住關鍵主管與工程師，同樣牽動後續表現。TD Cowen認為，重要人才的去留與公司的留才決策，都將成為影響股價的因素。

news.Title: Nvidia Without Huang Has It Harder Than Apple Without Jobs, DA Davidson Says
news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

Nvidia Corp. ( NASDAQ:NVDA ) fell 3.77% as of 10:30 a.m. ET after DA Davidson lowered its price target from $300 to $200 and kept a Buy rating, following Thursday's resignation of CEO Jensen Huang.

Warning! GuruFocus has detected 3 Warning Signs with NVDA.

Is NVDA fairly valued? Test your thesis with our free DCF calculator.

Analyst Gil Luria expects a challenging few months because Huang's exit wasn't planned, and compared it with Steve Jobs' departure from Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ:AAPL ), saying Nvidia's case is harder for that reason. He said he has worked with interim CEO Colette Kress and believes she can move the company forward. DA Davidson expects Nvidia to keep its product leadership but doubts it will orchestrate the AI ecosystem the way Huang did. It also flagged Nvidia's Asia business, now under more scrutiny, as a short-term risk that could weigh on next year's numbers. The $200 target is based on 13x fiscal 2028 earnings.

Other brokers have also cut targets. Barclays lowered its target to $210, citing structural key man risk, and Needham cut to $200 while keeping a Buy rating. Wells Fargo kept its Overweight rating and $300 target. Nvidia reports its first results since Huang's exit on November 17.

news.Title: Coherent's Margin Expansion Steals the Spotlight in Q1 FY27
news.Content:
Coherent Corp. COHR delivered a notable improvement in profitability during the first quarter of fiscal 2027, reflecting stronger operational execution and improved cost efficiency. The company's expanding margins highlight its ability to translate business activity into higher earnings, strengthening its investment appeal.

The improvement is particularly encouraging as Coherent continues to operate in technology-intensive markets where manufacturing efficiency, product positioning and disciplined spending play important roles in determining profitability.

COHR's Gross Margin Expansion Signals Operating Strength

Coherent's non-GAAP gross margin increased to 40.6% in the first quarter of fiscal 2027 from 38.7% in the year-ago period, representing an expansion of 184 basis points.

This improvement suggests that the company is generating greater profitability from its revenue base. A stronger gross margin provides additional flexibility to invest in innovation, enhance manufacturing capabilities and pursue growth opportunities without placing excessive pressure on earnings.

Improved Cost Efficiency Strengthens COHR's Profitability

Coherent's operating expenses declined to 17.4% of revenues from 19.2% a year earlier, marking a reduction of 183 basis points.

The lower expense ratio indicates improving operating leverage and more efficient resource utilization. This progress is particularly important for a company operating across competitive photonics and advanced materials markets.

Consequently, non-GAAP operating margin expanded 368 basis points to 23.2% from 19.5% in the comparable year-ago quarter.

Earnings Growth Reinforces COHR's Margin Momentum

The combined benefits of stronger gross profitability and tighter expense management supported a substantial improvement in earnings.

Non-GAAP earnings per share surged approximately 80% year over year to $2.09 from $1.16.

Sustaining these improvements could strengthen Coherent's earnings trajectory. However, competitive pressures, manufacturing costs and fluctuations in customer demand remain important considerations for investors assessing the durability of its profitability gains.

How Do Industry Peers Compare With COHR?

Lumentum Holdings Inc. LITE and Fabrinet FN are two U.S.-listed companies with significant exposure to the optical communications market.

Lumentum develops advanced photonic components and optical technologies used in data centers, telecommunications networks and industrial applications. Increasing requirements for high-speed connectivity create growth opportunities for Lumentum.

Story Continues

Fabrinet specializes in precision optical and electronic manufacturing services, supporting customers that develop sophisticated communications equipment. Growing demand for advanced optical systems provides opportunities for Fabrinet to expand its manufacturing operations.

While Lumentum competes through photonic innovation and product development, Fabrinet focuses on manufacturing expertise, production scalability and operational efficiency. Both companies face evolving customer requirements.

COHR's Price Performance & Estimates

COHR stock has surged 61% over the past year against the industry's 17% decline.

news.Content:

Bank of America ( NYSE:BAC ) is flagging a risk for traders betting against Asian stocks after an AI-led selloff drew intervention from Taiwan and South Korea, according to Seeking Alpha's headline. news.Title: Google Maps makes major change after 20-year standoff
news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

Alphabet Inc. ( GOOGL , Financials ) has deleted South Korean location coordinates from Google Maps and Google Earth to comply with national security standards, South Korean officials said on Friday.The revisions come after Seoul reversed a regulation in place for over two decades and allowed Google's request to export high-precision map data in February.South Korea has denied similar requests in 2007 and 2016, citing worries that precise mapping information may reveal military and security sites.Google will also have to delete Street View photographs of critical places under the new rules.The ministry cautioned that major breaches might lead to suspension or cancelation of the export authorization.South Korean navigation startup TMAP Mobility has apparently been picked by Google to analyze local map information.The partnership would allow Google to use security-approved data handled on domestic servers, possibly starting next year.The collaboration includes static information such as roads, buildings and addresses. It does not contain personal user information, real-time locations and driving routes.The decision might bolster Alphabet's mapping services in South Korea while still requiring compliance with local security rules.The next milestone is the anticipated incorporation of TMAP processed data into Google's mapping services in 2027.

news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

Amazon.com Inc. ( AMZN , Financials ) is considering building a global product database to minimize buyers' use of Google and other websites, according to a Reuters-reviewed internal document.World Product Graph gathers data on internet-sold products, including Amazon-missing items. Compare goods, find newer models, and buy without leaving Amazon.The initiative would merge manufacturer and retail website data. Coke and Bayer are sharing product information, and Amazon is considering a Procter & Gamble experiment.Amazon's Alexa for Shopping, formerly Rufus, may benefit from the project. The assistant's replies were wrong or partial, and the service was pricey, according to an internal paper.Amazon refuted the paper, stating their shopping assistant is 97% accurate worldwide. This suggestion also reflects competition from AI shopping bots that can compare and buy across sites.Retail sales and advertising income depend on Amazon's shopping traffic. According to the corporation, the paper is preliminary and may not reflect its current goals.A launch plan has not been verified by Amazon, however the concept included an October 2027 start date.What Amazon does with the database and AI-powered retail services will interest investors.

news.Title: You Can Do Better Than Tesla: 3 Industrial Stocks With More Upside

Tesla (NASDAQ: TSLA) has been one of the most popular stocks on Wall Street for years, attracting legions of supporters. It has single-handedly changed the public perception of electric vehicles (EVs) and even earned a spot in the " Magnificent Seven" grouping of the most influential tech stocks.

But today's Tesla faces plenty of headwinds, including shrinking margins and a softening EV market. So perhaps it's time for investors to turn their attention to other industrial stocks that may be better buys over the next few years.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 16x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

Here are three that fit the bill: Caterpillar (NYSE: CAT), Lockheed Martin (NYSE: LMT), and GE Vernova (NYSE: GEV).

Caterpillar's AI business is building up steam

Caterpillar is best known for its giant yellow construction equipment, but there's another reason for investors to be excited. It's becoming an increasingly important supplier to the artificial intelligence (AI) industry. And its latest earnings report shows just how quickly that business is growing.

Revenue in the third quarter was $20.7 billion, up 17% from a year ago, with power-generation revenue increasing 75%. The company manufactures engines and turbines that power data centers, which are being built at a breakneck pace to support AI workloads.

Even better, it ended the quarter with a $78 billion order backlog, nearly double what it reported a year earlier. That's a substantial amount of future business already on the books.

The company is also becoming more profitable. Its operating margin improved to 20.4% from 17.3% a year earlier, helped by favorable pricing. Earnings per share climbed to $7.13 from $4.88.

Construction and mining equipment will remain important to the business. But with AI infrastructure spending showing little sign of slowing, its power generation division gives investors another compelling reason to own the stock.

Lockheed Martin has a huge backlog

With the war in Iran, continued fighting in Ukraine, and the U.S. proposal for a mammoth $1.5 trillion defense budget next year, there's plenty to like about leading defense contractor Lockheed Martin.

The company makes F-35 fighter jets and missile interceptors, among other weaponry. And as the U.S. seeks to replenish its weapons stockpiles, the order book is growing at an impressive pace. Its backlog in the third quarter was a record $292 billion, up 27% sequentially. That includes a $52.5 billion multiyear contract for PAC-3 missile interceptors.

Story Continues

Management now expects free cash flow of $7.8 billion to $8 billion this year, up from its previous forecast of $7 billion to $7.2 billion.

GE Vernova is cashing in on the boom in electricity demand

AI companies are spending billions on data centers, but all those computers need something that isn't always easy to find: electricity. That's creating an enormous opportunity for GE Vernova, which manufactures gas turbines and equipment that moves electricity across the power grid.

And business is booming. Revenue in the third quarter was $12.6 billion, up 27% from a year ago. Management said that the Power division increased by 25%, while Electrification revenue jumped 51%, including contributions from acquisitions.

But the real eye-opener was the order book. GE Vernova booked $29.3 billion in new business during the quarter, which nearly doubled its organic orders from a year earlier. The company's backlog increased to $197 billion, up $20 billion sequentially.

With electricity demand growing and customers lining up for equipment, it has years of business already on its books. That's a compelling reason for investors to remain bullish.

3 industrial stocks that are better than Tesla

All three of these companies are outperforming Tesla, whose stock is in the red so far in 2026 (down 13%), while both Lockheed Martin and GE Vernova are up more than 20%. Caterpillar has a modest 6% gain, but that's only because of a recent dip on some bearish post-election sentiment around data center construction.

Looking ahead, I like all three of these more than Tesla in 2027, and I think they deserve attention from any investor seeking strong industrial stocks.

news.Title: Apollo Finvest (India) Ltd (BOM:512437) (Q2 2027) Earnings Call Highlights: Apollo Cash Scales ...
news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

Release Date: November 06, 2026

For the complete transcript of the earnings call, please refer to the full earnings call transcript .

Positive Points

Apollo Finvest (India) Ltd ( BOM:512437 ) reported a dramatic ramp-up in disbursement volumes, with revenue and profit also increasing at a healthy net profit margin.

Apollo Cash has shown strong product-market fit, disbursing over INR 65 crores across 1.6 lakh loans with 5 lakh+ downloads, largely through organic channels without Google or Facebook ads.

The company is investing in security and platform stability, with nearly 100% of engineering bandwidth focused on making the platform secure and scalable for future growth.

Apollo Finvest (India) Ltd ( BOM:512437 ) is enhancing its underwriting model using real-time data to improve approval rates, reduce risk, and enable smarter loan amount allocation.

The company has a strong balance sheet with minimal leverage, providing significant headroom to scale without immediate external capital; management believes it can double or triple lending volumes before needing additional funding.

Negative Points

Apollo Finvest (India) Ltd ( BOM:512437 ) has not yet conducted meaningful marketing, so the scalability of customer acquisition through paid channels remains unproven.

The company's underwriting model is still evolving, and the next version with better approval rates and risk differentiation is not yet launched, posing execution risk.

Apollo Finvest (India) Ltd ( BOM:512437 ) has not provided specific growth targets or timelines, citing a preference to 'under promise and over deliver,' which may leave investors without clear guidance.

The ideal customer profile is not yet clearly defined, as management states it is too early to categorize the target user, which could affect marketing efficiency.

The company may need to raise debt in the future to sustain growth, and while there is interest from lenders, the timing and terms of such financing are uncertain.

Q & A Highlights

Warning! GuruFocus has detected 4 Warning Signs with BOM:512437.

Is BOM:512437 fairly valued? Test your thesis with our free DCF calculator.

Q : How does Apollo Finvest plan to balance the seemingly conflicting goals of increasing approval rates and ticket sizes while simultaneously reducing loss rates in its underwriting model? A : Managing Director and CEO Mikhil Inani acknowledged that these goals appear to point in different directions, but explained that machine learning makes it possible. With six to seven months of live Apollo Cash data now available, the company can build models specific to its own borrowers. Better data lets it separate good, average, and bad borrowers more precisely, so loss rates can fall even as approvals and ticket sizes rise. He illustrated that if 20 of 100 borrowers default but hold only 1% of total AUM, the loss rate is 1%, not 20% the fine-tuning the model must master.

Story Continues

Q : How will Apollo Finvest manage marketing spend and unit economics so that return on marketing investment stays positive as it scales? A : CEO Mikhil Inani said the company believes in "product marketing" rather than marketing alone. The product must first prove itself organically with elite-level funnels and minimal drop-offs at every gate KYC, offers, underwriting before the company earns the right to spend even one rupee on customer acquisition. The focus will be marketing efficiency, not mindshare or vanity brand-building, with spend targeted only at audiences that deliver demonstrable bottom-line impact and good risk performance.

Q : At what point will Apollo Cash outgrow the current balance sheet, and how will the company finance its growth? A : CEO Mikhil Inani said the company has already made provisions to borrow about INR 100 crore from the debt market if required. Leverage is close to zero for an NBFC, leaving substantial headroom. He noted strong interest from fintech-focused lenders, especially since the Apollo Cash launch, and said the company will enter the debt market at the appropriate time as it scales.

Q : What are the repayment timelines for Apollo Cash loans, and how much can volumes grow before external capital is needed? A : CEO Mikhil Inani said loans are currently offered for three and six months, with nine- and 12-month tenures under exploration. Many borrowers repay well before the due date, treating the facility like a credit card. With roughly INR 20-22 crore of lending per month, he believes volumes can comfortably double or triple without significant external capital. The company would likely engage lenders only when reaching 80%-90% of available capital, possibly in a couple of quarters.

Q : Why did fees and commission income rise in Q2 compared with Q1? A : CEO Mikhil Inani attributed the increase to Apollo Cash becoming more prominent in the financials. Unlike the partnership business, where revenue is shared, Apollo Cash is on the company's own book, so processing fees, interest, and every other customer revenue line flow directly into its P&L, lifting revenue and profit.

Q : What is the target disbursement volume for Apollo Cash by the end of the financial year? A : CEO Mikhil Inani declined to give a specific number, citing the company's "under promise and over deliver" mantra. He said Apollo Finvest has very ambitious plans, reflected in its focus on refining the product, algorithm, and platform ahead of a major marketing push, and in the senior team it is assembling. He said the team is being built to "do something titanic," with a long runway ahead.

Q : Who is the ideal target customer for Apollo Cash? A : CEO Mikhil Inani said it is too early to define a single cohort, as all current traction is largely organic with no meaningful marketing. He sees resonance across three or four borrower segments and wants about 12 months of marketing-led testing before drawing firm conclusions. For now, the customers finding value are highly digitally savvy, experienced with digital lending, and comfortable with both the technology and the responsibilities of the lending ecosystem.

Q : What is the status of hiring, and how is the team being built for the next phase of growth? A : Whole-Time Director and CFO Diksha Nangia said hiring is the single most important thing happening at Apollo, with the CFO personally involved in every senior hire. This quarter the company onboarded a head of marketing from the fintech space, and a head of engineering is expected to join soon. All senior hires come from digital lending with at least five years of experience. The tech team now makes up about 43% of the company, and the engineering team alone grew 3x in one quarter.

Q : What are the key operational priorities at Apollo Finvest right now? A : CEO Mikhil Inani said the company is consolidating and laying foundations across technology, data science, collections, marketing, and finance. Priorities include security and platform stability with nearly 100% of engineering bandwidth devoted to making the platform secure and scalable for a targeted 10x growth plus a next-generation underwriting model aimed at better approval rates, better risk rates, and smarter loan amount allocation, all feeding into efficient marketing.

Q : How has Apollo Cash performed since launch? A : CEO Mikhil Inani said Apollo Cash has disbursed over INR 65 crore across nearly 1.6 lakh loans, with more than 5 lakh downloads, scaling roughly 60x in six to seven months largely without Google or Facebook ads. He called it a solid start that demonstrates clear product-market fit and demand, while stressing that significant opportunity remains uncaptured.

news.Title: Amazon Eyes Products It Doesn't Sell in AI Shopping Tussle
news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

Amazon ( NASDAQ:AMZN ) is exploring a catalog that would cover products it doesn't sell, Reuters reported Friday. The idea is to give shoppers fewer reasons to leave Amazon when they're comparing products. That matters for shareholders because AI shopping agents can steer customers to rival retailers before they ever see a sponsored listing on Amazon.

Warning! GuruFocus has detected 6 Warning Signs with AMZN.

Is AMZN fairly valued? Test your thesis with our free DCF calculator.

The internal proposal, called World Product Graph, would collect details such as specifications, model release dates and color options from brands and other retailers' websites. Reuters reported that the draft included an October 2027 target date. Amazon said the document was outdated and might not reflect its current plans.

The proposal targets a gap in how people shop online. In 2025 research cited by Reuters, Morgan Stanley found that 57% of online shoppers started product research on Google, versus 16% on Amazon. When shoppers already knew what they wanted, Amazon led Google 41% to 23%.

Amazon already has a way to put that data to work. Its Alexa for Shopping assistant can compare products, track prices and make purchases. Amazon says more than 400 million customers worldwide used its AI shopping assistance over the past year. Advertising services generated $19.6 billion in the September quarter, up 11% year over year.

Investors Takeaway

The holiday shopping season offers an early test of whether Alexa's expanding U.S. text-to-shop rollout brings customers back and turns more product searches into orders. Amazon's next earnings report will provide a broader read through advertising and third-party seller services growth. Repeat use and purchase conversion would give investors a clearer measure of the assistant's impact if Amazon discloses them.

For the proposed catalog, confirmed brand partnerships would show whether Amazon can keep product information current at scale. If rival agents become the place shoppers start, Amazon could still fulfill orders while losing some opportunities to sell ads along the way.

In an interview with CNBC earlier this month, Ackman said he does not see a repeat of the Roaring 1920s in the stock market. He sees more froth in private venture markets, where fear of missing out drives deals, but said much of it is justified. He called AI a global race for superintelligence and said the United States cannot afford to finish second.

In a separate interview with the Milken Institute, Ackman said the impact of AI will be the story of 2026, 2027 and probably 2028. He said the cost of intelligence is falling and called intelligence the most valuable asset in the world. He believes the AI spending boom is sustainable because big tech companies have the cash and credit to raise capital, and because the return on computing power is well above the cost of capital. He worries more about pure-play neocloud companies, which he compared to highly leveraged real estate developers. He sees no repeat of the 1999 internet bubble because AI companies such as Anthropic run profitable, fast-growing businesses, he said.

Below are the eight stocks that appear in both Ackman's portfolio and Cramer's commentary, ranked by the number of hedge funds that hold them. You can click to read the expanded list of 8 Stocks Bill Ackman and Jim Cramer Are Bullish On .

Methodology

To compile our list of the 8 best stocks to buy according to Bill Ackman and Jim Cramer, we read Pershing Square Holdings' third-quarter shareholder letter, released on November 2, 2026. We picked stocks that Pershing Square holds and that CNBC host Jim Cramer has been bullish on. This gave us eight companies.

Story Continues

We ranked the eight companies in ascending order by the number of hedge funds that held stakes in them at the end of the second quarter of 2026. The hedge fund count comes from Insider Monkey's database of 1,006 hedge funds.

For each company, we also cover Ackman's investment thesis and the value of Pershing Square Holdings' position as of September 30, 2026. These figures show the fund's reported economic exposure, which includes shares held directly and exposure through certain derivatives.

Why are we interested in the stocks that hedge funds pile into? The reason is simple: our research has shown that we can outperform the market by imitating the top stock picks of the best hedge funds. Insider Monkey's quarterly newsletter strategy selects 14 small-cap and large-cap stocks every quarter and has returned 612% since May 2014, beating its benchmark by 375 percentage points (see more details here ).

Number of Hedge Fund Holders: 194

Visa Inc. (NYSE:V) is another payment company that Bill Ackman and Jim Cramer both support.

During a February 25, 2026, episode of Mad Money, Cramer answered a caller who was worried about Visa's share price and repeated his positive view of the company. He called Visa and Mastercard excellent growth businesses and said he slightly prefers Mastercard.

Cramer also said investors should consider buying these payment companies when market sentiment turns negative, because their stock prices fall out of favor from time to time even when their businesses stay strong.

Visa is also a common stock pick between Claude, Ackman and President Trump, as we covered earlier. Click to see why .

Ackman's Pershing Square Holdings reported approximately $644.5 million in economic exposure to Visa as of September 30, representing 4.9% of its net assets.

In his third-quarter letter, Ackman highlighted Visa's strong results. Organic revenue grew 12%, earnings per share rose 17% and value-added services revenue grew about 27%, all from the same quarter a year earlier. Higher payment volumes and continued growth in international transactions supported the results.

Ackman also addressed concerns that stablecoins and artificial intelligence could disrupt the traditional payments industry. Pershing Square sees these technologies as opportunities, because they could create more transactions for Visa.

Visa has expanded its stablecoin infrastructure offerings and introduced tools that let banks and financial technology companies issue and manage digital currencies. It has also built tools that let AI agents make secure transactions.

Ackman believes Visa's valuation of about 24 times forward earnings remains attractive. Pershing Square expects the company to benefit from continued double-digit revenue growth and mid-to-high-teens earnings growth over the coming years. ChatGPT also agrees with Ackman on Visa, and we looked at its reasons. Read the full analysis here .

#3 Meta Platforms, Inc. (NASDAQ:META)

Number of Hedge Fund Holders: 254

Meta Platforms, Inc. (NASDAQ:META) is among the artificial intelligence stocks that both Jim Cramer and Bill Ackman favor.

During an October 6 episode of Mad Money, Cramer named Meta and Microsoft as two of his preferred ways to invest in artificial intelligence. He argued that established technology companies with strong management teams and profitable existing businesses are better positioned to profit from AI than speculative companies whose future depends entirely on the technology.

Cramer expressed confidence in Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg's ability to turn the company's AI investments into profitable new products and services.

Ackman's Pershing Square Holdings reported approximately $1.49 billion in economic exposure to Meta as of September 30, equivalent to 11.2% of the fund's net assets.

In his Q3 shareholder letter, Ackman highlighted Meta's improving advertising business. Meta's core advertising business grew revenue 26% in the third quarter from a year earlier, as AI-driven improvements in content recommendations and ad targeting lifted engagement and monetization.

Ackman also expressed optimism about Meta's newly launched Muse personal AI agent and Meta Enterprise Platform. He believes these products could create additional revenue opportunities beyond the company's core advertising business and help justify its large investment in computing infrastructure. Ackman points to Muse as Meta's new way to earn money, and we looked at whether the AI agent can really help the stock. Check the full analysis here .

Although Meta's valuation rose from 18 times to about 22 times forward earnings, Ackman still considers the stock undervalued.

Pershing Square expects Meta to generate annual earnings growth of 20% or more over the next several years, supported by its advertising business and emerging AI opportunities. Ackman first bought Meta after its third-quarter 2025 results, and we covered why he called the valuation cheap. Click to read the story .

#2 Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT)

Number of Hedge Fund Holders: 273

Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) is one of the strongest areas of agreement between Jim Cramer and Bill Ackman.

During a recent Mad Money episode, Cramer named Microsoft as one of his preferred AI investments, citing its established business model, leadership and ability to make money from artificial intelligence through existing products.

Microsoft can sell new AI tools faster than most rivals because its software already runs inside almost every large company, and we laid out the full bull case. Read the bull case here .

Ackman also praised Microsoft's efforts to expand its AI capabilities through Copilot, its own AI models, custom Maia chips and new enterprise security products.

Microsoft shares rose sharply, and the stock's forward earnings multiple climbed from 19 times to about 25 times. Even so, Pershing Square maintained that the stock remained undervalued. Cramer said a slowdown in data center construction could help established cloud companies, and Microsoft ranks second among the five stocks he is bullish on. Click to see his full list .

Even with these results, Pershing Square believes investors put too much emphasis on Amazon's huge capital spending plans. The company expected to spend approximately $220 billion on capital expenditures in 2026, and management said it expects to spend meaningfully more in 2027.

news.Title: Forget the "Magnificent Seven." Berkshire Hathaway Could Be the Better Long-Term Bet.
news.Content:
The Magnificent Seven stocks have not been so magnificent as of late. The Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF (NYSEMKT:MAGS), which invests exclusively in those seven mega-caps dubbed magnificent, has underperformed the S&P 500 this year.

The exchange-traded fund , which invests in just seven stocks -- Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA), Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL), Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT), Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN), Meta Platforms (NASDAQ:META), Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOG), and Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA) -- is up just 2.8% year to date (YTD) and 4% over the past 12 months.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

On one end of the spectrum, Apple stock has outperformed, up 28% YTD and 29% over the past year. Amazon and Microsoft have been solid, if not spectacular, with Amazon up 17% YTD and 8% over the past year and Microsoft up 10% YTD and 5% over the past 12 months. Meta (-3%), Alphabet (-9%), Nvidia (-10%), and Tesla (-16%) are all down YTD.

Image source: Getty Images.

Another mega-cap, Berkshire Hathaway (NYSE:BRKB), is the 13th-largest company in the world. Its stock price is up 16% YTD and 18% over the past 12 months. Is Berkshire Hathaway stock the better buy right now?

A bump in the road

Of course, while the Magnificent Seven stocks have struggled this year, they have been juggernauts over the past 10 years, leading the AI revolution. Their long-term returns reflect that, as the chart below shows.

Nvidia, for example, has averaged a 58% annualized return over the past 10 years, while Apple has averaged a 29% return. Only Meta has averaged less than a 20% return over the past decade, with an average annualized 10-year return of 18%.

BRK.B data by YCharts

The recent swoon by most of the Magnificent Seven stocks is due to a variety of factors, most of them specific to the individual companies. If there are overriding trends hurting most of these mega-caps, it is their generally high valuations and concerns about overspending on AI.

Some of the Magnificent Seven stocks are great buys right now, trading at significant discounts. Some of them are not great buys. But the perfect complement to any Magnificent Seven holdings you might have is Berkshire Hathaway.

Berkshire: The perfect complement

Over the past 60 years, since Warren Buffett became CEO of a small textile manufacturing company back in 1965, Berkshire Hathaway stock has posted an average annual return of 20%.

Story Continues

That's the type of long-term performance and consistency that investors should covet in any stock, including Nvidia, Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, and other tech giants.

As a value stock, Berkshire is the perfect complement to Magnificent Seven stocks and AI leaders, as this year's divergent performance shows. The company is a conglomerate of some 70 different companies and a $335 billion stock portfolio.

Buffett's strategies, and those of his successor, Greg Abel, focus on companies and investments that are good value, well-managed, and financially sound, with strong competitive advantages. These qualities, in turn, make Berkshire Hathaway a sturdy, rock-solid investment over the long term, but especially in choppy and uncertain markets.

Technologies change, and the Magnificent Seven may look very different 20 years from now than they do today. But Berkshire Hathaway will likely still play that same role in your portfolio, adding balance and ballast during tough times, and great long-term performance.

news.Title: Apple Is the World’s Largest Company, and Nvidia Is Second. Here’s What $10,000 Invested in Each Today Could Be Worth by the End of Next Year.
news.Content:
After news broke that Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang admitted to having an affair with a tech company executive who is now accused of being a Chinese spy, the market heavily sold off the stock. After a series of further revelations and allegations, and Huang's announcement on Thursday that he was resigning from the top job at the company he co-founded, the shares are now down around 30% from their all-time high,

Its plunge over the course of the past month has cost the chipmaker its position as the world's largest company.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

In its place, Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) has regained the title, and now holds it by a pretty wide margin. As of the close of trading Thursday, Apple had a $5.1 trillion market cap, while Nvidia's sat at $4 trillion.

Yet the market is always shifting. What might a $10,000 investment in each of these tech giants be worth by the end of 2027?

Image source: Getty Images.

Apple has thrived through CEO transitions

Apple isn't a new company by any means. It went through a much-scrutinized CEO transition when co-founder Steve Jobs resigned in 2011, but it came out of the Tim Cook era stronger than ever. While the jury is still out on new CEO John Ternus, Apple is such a strong company that he will likely do just fine.

I think stories like this are what Nvidia investors should cling to with Huang stepping down. True, he has been a visionary leader, but the reality is that Nvidia is loaded with talent and someone can likely replace him and keep the ship on course — even if that person turns out not to be interim CEO Colette Kress, Nvidia's well-respected CFO.

As a result, I think investors should view this month's sell-off as a buying opportunity, as it has likely been overdone.

Apple's stock is expensive compared to Nvidia's

These two trade at very different price-to-earnings ratios. Apple is almost twice as expensive, with a P/E of 39, while Nvidia's is now 21.

NVDA PE Ratio data by YCharts

Furthermore, Wall Street analysts expect much greater growth out of Nvidia over the next few years. For its fiscal 2027, which began Sept. 27, Wall Street expects Apple to grow by 15%. For Nvidia's fiscal 2028, which will begin in late January 2027, they expect Nvidia to grow at a 68% pace. That huge mismatch means the gap in their valuation figures will be even more exaggerated by the end of next year.

Story Continues

So, what would $10,000 investments made in Nvidia and Apple today look like by the end of next year?

For Apple, I expect a $10,000 investment will be worth roughly the same. The reality is that Apple is trading near the top of its historical valuation range, and I don't think it's likely to get much more expensive. As a result, its earnings growth over the next year will help offset that expensive valuation, and the stock will be relatively flat.

For Nvidia, the narratives that are dragging on its price now will be far in the rearview mirror by this time next year. Big changes may be ahead for the chipmaker, but what isn't changing is massive demand for AI computing hardware . Nvidia is still the category leader here and has built a massive lead over the competition. That will likely survive a CEO transition, and will allow Nvidia's growth to do the talking. If it grows at a nearly 70% pace and its valuation rises to a more respectable level, I don't see why Nvidia couldn't double a $10,000 investment into $20,000 by the end of next year.

That would make Nvidia a top stock to buy now, while Apple could underperform thanks to how expensive it is.

news.Title: TSMC’s Terrific Growth Clearly Shows That the Chip Sell-Off Is Overdone. Here Are the Best Stocks to Buy Hand Over Fist
news.Content:
The semiconductor sector has been under immense pressure lately, as evidenced by the 17% decline in the PHLX Semiconductor Sector index since the beginning of October. However, results from leading semiconductor companies clearly indicate that the sell-off is overdone.

Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (NYSE:TSM), one of the world's most important semiconductor companies, just released its October sales figures, providing further evidence that the artificial intelligence (AI) build-out isn't slowing down. Let's see how TSMC fared in October before taking a look at some top semiconductor stocks that are worth buying following the recent sell-off.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 16x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

Image source: Getty Images.

The AI chip boom will help TSMC sustain its incredible growth

TSMC's October revenue increased nearly 60% from the year-ago period. What's worth noting is that its growth has gained solid momentum lately. TSMC's revenue in July, August, and September increased by 45%, 53%, and 55%, respectively, compared to the respective year-ago periods.

It isn't surprising to see this acceleration in TSMC's growth. The company noted on its October earnings call that it is seeing "continued robust multi-year demand from our customers," driven by the growing adoption of agentic AI and open-source AI models. TSMC management further pointed out that the "value of semiconductors in the global supply chain is set to continue to increase," as chips will play an essential role in the AI build-out.

TSMC's revenue has increased by 43.3% in the first 10 months of 2026. The recent acceleration in growth suggests it could exceed its 2026 revenue growth target of 44%. Also, TSMC's long-term earnings per share (EPS) growth estimates have taken off this year.

TSM EPS LT Growth Estimates data by YCharts

That's why buying TSMC stock following its double-digit slide since October's beginning is a smart move, especially considering that it trades at an attractive 18 times forward earnings. However, this isn't the only chip stock that's benefiting from the AI boom. Let's take a closer look at another name worth buying right now.

This semiconductor company is essential to the AI build-out

TSMC management pointed out last month that it is on track to spend $60-$64 billion on capital expenditure this year. That will be a significant bump over its 2025 capital expenditure of $40.9 billion. The company sees its capital expenditure between 2026 and 2028 to be "significantly higher than the past three years."

Story Continues

This is great news for ASML Holding (NASDAQ:ASML), which manufactures the extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography machines that help TSMC build its advanced AI chips. ASML stock has dropped by more than 15% since the beginning of October. It now trades at 23 times forward earnings, lower than its five-year average forward price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio of 32.5.

That's quite attractive for a company that reported a 136% year-over-year increase in EPS in Q3 2026. Even better, ASML sees persistently strong demand for its chipmaking equipment over the coming years, outpacing its production capacity.

As a result, the company aims to increase the output of its EUV lithography systems by 30% in 2027. Management is exploring the possibility of increasing output by more than 30% in 2028. Given that ASML has a monopoly in EUV lithography, it can charge customers like TSMC a premium. So, it's not surprising that its long-term growth estimates have jumped significantly.

ASML EPS LT Growth Estimates data by YCharts

However, ASML could easily outpace those expectations. Its EPS jumped significantly in Q3, and it can sustain robust long-term growth due to its monopoly, higher capital spending by customers like TSMC, and continued investments in AI infrastructure.

Investors, therefore, can consider adding both ASML and TSMC to their portfolios, as they are well-positioned to capitalize on the AI-fueled chip boom over the long run and are trading at attractive levels.

news.Title: ASX Stock Surges 148% in a Year: Is More Upside Still Ahead?
news.Content:
Shares of ASE Technology Holding ASX have rallied 148.4% over the past year, dramatically outperforming the Electronics-Semiconductors industry's 13.1% return and the broader Computer and Technology sector's 10.9% gain. The development reflects accelerating demand for advanced packaging and testing as artificial intelligence (AI) systems require more powerful, interconnected chips.

ASX also outpaced semiconductor peers Entegris ENTG, Marvell Technology MRVL and FormFactor FORM, which surged 95.7%, 90.2% and 84.1%, respectively. Although these companies operate at different stages of the semiconductor supply chain, the comparison highlights ASX's momentum. After such a rally, investors must assess whether improving earnings and a relatively modest valuation leave further upside. Let's analyze.

ASX Stock Performance: One-Year Comparison

Image Source: Zacks Investment Research

AI and Advanced Packaging Drive ASX's Growth

Third-quarter 2026 results underline how rapidly ASE Technology's business mix is changing. Consolidated revenues jumped 44.8% year over year to NT$244.2 billion, while operating profit surged 151% to NT$33.1 billion. Net income attributable to shareholders of the parent increased 148% to NT$27 billion. These results demonstrate that the rally is supported by substantial improvements in business performance.

Its assembly and testing business (ATM) posted revenue growth of 51% to NT$151.5 billion, reflecting stronger demand for leading-edge services and fuller utilization across conventional operations.

At the center is leading-edge advanced packaging (LEAP), which enables complex multichip systems. Demand continues to exceed available LEAP capacity, supporting volumes and a favorable pricing environment. Computing's share of ATM revenues increased to 34% from 25% a year earlier, underscoring ASX's growing exposure to AI accelerators, servers and related infrastructure.

The company raised its 2026 LEAP revenue expectation from $3.7 billion to more than $4 billion and anticipates doubling this business in 2027. Full-process advanced packaging, expected to contribute approximately $300 million this year, is projected to exceed $1 billion in 2027. These targets provide growth visibility, although delivery depends on expanding manufacturing capacity.

Co-packaged optics (CPO) adds another growth avenue. ASX expects more than $500 million in CPO revenues in 2027 as mass production ramps, potentially extending its role in high-speed AI networking. Meanwhile, its electronic manufacturing services (EMS) operation is moving toward high-performance computing, optical and power-related products, broadening opportunities beyond traditional consumer electronics.

Story Continues

Margin Expansion and Capacity Additions Support Growth

Profitability is improving alongside revenues. ATM gross margin expanded 800 basis points year over year to 30.6% in the third quarter, while its operating margin reached 20%, up from 10.8%. Consolidated gross margin rose to 22.1%, with operating margin reaching 13.6%.

A richer LEAP mix and higher factory utilization have strengthened operating leverage, creating scope for further gains as capacity becomes productive.

Capacity additions are crucial. ASX has 22 building projects underway in Taiwan, with more than half expected to support revenues through 2027. Its 2026 capital spending plan increased to $11.5 billion, with spending expected to rise further in 2027. These investments position the company to meet unmet demand but heighten execution risks surrounding equipment installation and factory readiness.

ASX's Q4 Outlook and Upward Revisions Signal Momentum

The near-term outlook is encouraging. For fourth-quarter 2026, ASX projects consolidated revenue growth of 6%-8% sequentially, gross margin of 23%-24% and operating margin of 14.5%-15.5%. ATM revenues should rise 11%-13% sequentially, with ATM gross margin expanding another 100-200 basis points. These expectations suggest that the favorable mix shift has further to run.

Earnings estimates have moved higher. The Zacks Consensus Estimate for ASX's 2026 earnings is pegged at $1.31 per share, implying 129.8% year-over-year growth. The 2027 EPS estimate stands at $2.22, indicating a further increase of 69.5%. Over the past 30 days, 2026 and 2027 earnings estimates have increased from $1.27 and $2.09 per share, compared with $1.23 and $1.99, respectively, 60 days ago.

These upward revisions reinforce the improving earnings outlook, although investors should monitor whether capacity expansion translates into the projected revenue and profitability.

ASX Earnings Estimates and Revision Trends

Valuation: ASX's P/S Discount Offers Perspective

Despite its rally, ASX trades at a trailing 12-month price-to-sales (P/S) multiple of 3.33X, far below the Electronics-Semiconductors industry's 9.06X. Its valuation also trails ENTG's 6.69X, FORM's 7.48X and MRVL's 16.03X. This discount is notable given ASE's rising AI exposure.

ASX's Value Score of D points to valuation concerns, serving as a warning that a relatively low P/S ratio does not necessarily imply a good buying opportunity. Nevertheless, its VGM Score of B indicates a clearly favorable overall profile under a proprietary methodology combining value, growth and momentum. Together, these signals support a constructive view without dismissing valuation risk.

ASX Price-to-Sales (TTM) Ratio

End Note

A surge of nearly 148% in ASE Technology does not necessarily mean that its growth story has come to an end. Expanding LEAP capacity, full-process packaging, rising CPO opportunities, improving margins and upward earnings revisions support its longer-term prospects. Its discounted P/S and favorable VGM Score add support. Although higher debt, substantial CapEx and execution risks warrant monitoring, the company's growth visibility remains encouraging. Investors seeking long-term semiconductor exposure may consider buying ASX stock now to participate in its growth-driven opportunities.

ASX currently sports a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy). You can see the complete list of today's Zacks #1 Rank stocks here .

news.Title: Cisco: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
news.Content:
On its first-quarter fiscal year 2027 earnings call, held on Nov. 12, 2026, Cisco Systems (NASDAQ:CSCO) announced record quarterly revenue of $18.5 billion, up 24% year over year. Expanding hardware sales and rising artificial intelligence demand drive top-line momentum, showing how enterprise infrastructure investments translate into corporate earnings.

Three takeaways from the call clarify where the business is heading.

1. Hyperscaler Demand Drives AI Revenue Outlook

Large cloud providers are scaling data center architecture to handle automated artificial intelligence workloads. Cisco expects sales to these buyers to double as it integrates custom networking silicon into high-capacity systems.

Overall, our hyperscaler business continues to show strong momentum with AI infrastructure revenue projected to grow to $9 billion in fiscal year '27, more than double fiscal year '26 levels.

-- Charles Robbins, Chair and Chief Executive Officer

2. Reduced Headcount Expands Operating Leverage

Management trimmed workforce headcount while top-line revenue expanded, creating operating leverage. That financial discipline allows cash flow to grow faster than overall sales while funding share repurchases and dividends.

... total headcount has declined by a low single-digit percentage, driving an expected revenue per employee increase of approximately 19% based on our updated FY '27 guidance.

-- Mark Patterson, Chief Financial Officer

3. Enterprise Modernization Signals a Long-Term Refresh

Corporate clients are upgrading campus networks to support real-time automated computing and heightened security standards. Broad order expansion across customer types shows spending is spreading beyond initial cloud construction.

These broad-based results support our view that we are in the early stages of a multiyear, multibillion-dollar networking super cycle, as I referenced earlier, and we are executing with focus and urgency to capture this incremental opportunity.

Looking Ahead

Data center build-outs are accelerating across enterprise networks. Management monitors pricing discipline and component costs to protect profitability.

Product revenue growth was led by networking accelerating to 43% year-over-year growth with broad strength across the portfolio led by triple-digit growth in AI infrastructure and double-digit growth in data center switching and campus networking.

Enterprise clients continue upgrading private infrastructure alongside public cloud expansion.

Story Continues

We're truly in the very early stages of a multiyear networking super cycle, and we're confident in our ability to continue capturing the opportunity that it represents for Cisco.

news.Title: 精材與台積電簽逾7年產能外包協議　2029年量產後段先進封裝
news.Content:
（中央社記者鍾榮峰台北2026年11月13日電）半導體晶圓封測廠精材 (3374) 今天公告，董事會決議通過與台積電 (2330) 簽訂產能外包協議，在先進封裝後段製程展開合作，計劃在台積電中部科學園區廠房，建置產線並負責生產相關營運。

精材表示，相關產線建置及量產時程將依計畫時程逐步展開，全案規劃於2029年實現第一期產線量產。精材這次董事會也通過辦理發行新台幣150億元的轉換公司債，支應初期產能建置需求。

精材說明，這次與台積電簽署的產能外包協議，從今天起至2033年12月31日止，合作時程超過7年。

精材指出，人工智慧（AI）、高效能運算（HPC）與資料中心應用快速普及，市場對於先進封裝技術產能需求呈現結構性成長，透過台積電的支持，將投入包括生產設備及自動物料搬運系統（AMHS）方面資本支出，並負責製造與產線運營，成為CoWoS先進封裝供應鏈中oS模組的生力軍。

精材表示，預計結合自身封測營運經驗，在台積電先進封裝技術與製造能力支援下，雙方攜手確保新產線的技術規範、品質與良率符合台積電及全球客戶的嚴格要求。

news.Title: 5 High P/E Stocks Under the 200-Day SMA
news.Content:
A high price-to-earnings ratio usually reflects substantial expectations for a company's future earnings. But what happens when those expectations remain elevated even as the stock falls below its long-term trading average? That disconnect has become particularly relevant following the recent technology selloff, which has pressured several companies with strong growth prospects but demanding valuations.

The retreat has been especially visible in stocks exposed to artificial intelligence and semiconductor spending. Reuters reported on November 9 that a "month-long swoon" in technology and AI-related stocks in the week ended with the biggest one-day drop for the S&P 500 technology sector in more than six years.

The primary concern for investors is the Democratic victories in the midterm elections, which may lead to sluggish data-center spending, which makes up the center of the market rally. In other news, we compiled a list of the 10 Best Healthcare and Insurance Stocks To Buy Following the 2026 Democratic Midterm Sweep. Access the complete list here for free .

The 200-day simple moving average provides another perspective on these developments. By averaging a stock's closing prices over approximately 200 trading sessions, the indicator helps investors assess its longer-term price trend. A stock trading below this level may be experiencing sustained selling pressure, although the technical signal alone says little about whether its underlying business is undervalued.

DON'T MISS: Forget the High-Beta Hype: 10 'Sleep Well at Night' Stocks to Buy Now

This holds significance for investors when examining companies with elevated trailing P/E ratios. Some are established businesses generating substantial cash flow, while others have earnings that remain small relative to their market valuations. In both cases, a decline below the 200-day moving average does not necessarily make the stock inexpensive.

So what are the best high P/E stocks under the 200-Day SMA? Access the expanded list of 10 High P/E Stocks Under the 200-Day SMA . You can see the top 5 stocks below.

Our Methodology

To compile our list of the 10 High P/E Stocks Under the 200-Day SMA, we screened publicly traded companies to identify stocks trading below their 200-day simple moving averages. We then reviewed Yahoo Finance's trailing price-to-earnings ratios, retaining companies with trailing P/E ratios of at least 30 or negative trailing earnings. The selected stocks were ranked in ascending order according to the number of hedge funds holding stakes in them, based on Insider Monkey's hedge fund ownership data.

Story Continues

Why are we interested in the stocks that hedge funds pile into? The reason is simple: our research has shown that we can outperform the market by imitating the top stock picks of the best hedge funds. Insider Monkey's quarterly newsletter strategy selects 14 small-cap and large-cap stocks every quarter and has returned 612% since May 2014, beating its benchmark by 375 percentage points ( see more details here ).

10 High P/E Stocks Under the 200-Day SMA

5. Applied Materials, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMAT )

Trailing P/E: 31.97

Number of Hedge Fund Holders: 137

Applied Materials, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMAT) stands to benefit from increasingly complex semiconductor manufacturing processes, particularly those associated with advanced memory, leading-edge logic, and chip packaging. Its equipment is used in multiple stages of semiconductor production, making the company a supplier of manufacturing technologies rather than finished chips.

A key element of its investment case is the growing importance of materials engineering. As manufacturers seek improvements in chip performance and energy efficiency, Applied Materials has been developing equipment intended to address challenges in advanced packaging and high-bandwidth memory production.

READ ALSO: 10 Best Large Cap Tech Stocks to Buy According to Billionaires

Its third-quarter fiscal 2026 results demonstrated the financial strength of this business. Revenue increased 25% year over year to $9.12 billion, while GAAP operating margin improved to 33.7% from 30.6%. The improvement in profitability is particularly relevant because growing manufacturing complexity does not automatically translate into higher returns for equipment suppliers. Applied Materials has also expanded collaborative research through its EPIC Center, which reached 11 engagements with semiconductor companies, universities, and other technology partners.

However, equipment purchases remain tied to manufacturers' capital expenditure plans. Sustaining growth will require continued customer investment in advanced production technologies, while maintaining the margin improvements already evident in reported results.

4. Intel Corporation (NASDAQ: INTC )
