news.Title: Zacks Earnings Trends Highlights: Micron, Nvidia and Alphabet
news.Content:
For Immediate Release

Chicago, IL – November 13, 2026 – Zacks Director of Research Sheraz Mian says, "Excluding the Tech sector's substantial contribution, Q3 earnings for the rest of the S&P 500 index would be up +19.9% (vs. +28.8% otherwise)"

Q3 Earnings Results Reconfirm Broad-Based Strength as Outlook Improves

Note: The following is an excerpt from this week's Earnings Trends report. You can access the full report that contains detailed historical actual and estimates for the current and following periods, please click here>>>

Here are the key points:

The Q3 earnings season has reconfirmed the broad-based strength that we have been seeing in recent reporting cycles. The pace of earnings and revenue growth remains strong and broad-based. Even more notably, the revisions trend remains positive, with estimates for 2026 Q4 and full-year 2027 continuing to rise.

Total Q3 earnings for the 451 S&P 500 members that have reported results are up +24.6% from the same period last year on +13.5% higher revenues, with 82.5% beating EPS estimates and 74.9% beating revenue estimates. The proportion of these 451 index members beating both EPS and revenue estimates (the 'blended' beats percentage) is 65.4%.

Excluding the Tech sector's substantial contribution, Q3 earnings for the rest of the S&P 500 index would be up +19.9% (vs. +28.8% otherwise). Excluding the Energy sector, the aggregate growth rate would decline to +23.2%. Excluding both the Energy and Tech sectors, Q3 earnings for the rest of the index would be up +10.5% on +7.6% higher revenues.

Micron MU and Nvidia NVDA continue to be material contributors to the Tech sector's growth picture. Excluding Nvidia, Micron, and Alphabet GOOGL, which enjoyed an outsized gain in the preceding period, Q3 earnings for the rest of the Tech sector would be up +29.6% (vs. +45.5% otherwise).

The Tech Sector Earnings Scorecard

The Tech sector in general, and the broader AI basket in particular, has been in the eye of the storm in recent weeks, with worries about data center buildout, funding, and permitting in the spotlight. These worries have been weighing on these stocks' performance lately, as the one-month performance chart below ofMicron, Alphabet and the Zacks Tech sector relative to the S&P 500 index shows.

We deliberately used Alphabet and Micron in the chart above as a proxy for the high-quality part of the AI basket. Both companies are particularly relevant from an earnings standpoint, with Micron posting blockbuster results at the start of the Q3 reporting cycle while Alphabet famously failed to impress on that score.

Story Continues

Alphabet is hardly alone in struggling to beat consensus estimates in Q3, as the Tech sector as a whole has been at best average on this score.

These comparison charts show Q3 EPS and revenue beat percentages for 69 of the 89 S&P 500 companies that have already reported results. As you can see in the left-hand side chart, the Q3 EPS beats percentage for this group is tracking a hair above the average for the preceding 20 quarters for this same group of 69 Tech companies.

We noted earlier how Micron Technology has been a big contributor to the sector's strong growth this quarter, while Alphabet had joined Micron in the preceding period. Including both of these Tech players, the Tech sector's Q3 earnings are up +33.1% from the same period last year on +27.2% higher revenues.

Driving the unusually strong earnings growth number (+98.9%) in 2026 Q2 is because of Alphabet's booking of a huge gain on its SpaceX stake after that company's IPO. We typically strip out non-recurring gains and losses from our earnings data, but we decided to keep the Alphabet gain in, as having equity stakes in a variety of companies is actually part of its business, even as the SpaceX type of gain ends up distorting our aggregate data from a comparability standpoint, as is the case here.

Looking at Q3 as a whole, combining the actual results that have come out with estimates for the still-to-come Tech companies, total earnings are on track to increase by +45.5% from the same period last year on +34.7% higher revenues.

The sector's Q3 earnings growth pace drops to +29.6% from +45.5% once contributions from Micron, Alphabet, and Nvidia are excluded.

The Earnings Big Picture

We have shown how Q3 estimates have moved higher since the quarter got underway.

As is the case with estimates for 2026 Q4, estimates for full-year 2027 are also moving higher.

Since the beginning of July, estimates for 2027 have increased for 10 of the 16 Zacks sectors, with Tech, Energy, Finance and Industrials leading the way.

With 90.2% of the S&P 500 results already in, the revisions trend has remained consistently positive. We will keep a close watch on this key metric through the remainder of this reporting cycle.

news.Title: The Zacks Analyst Blog Highlights Tesla, SpaceX and Ford
news.Content:
For Immediate Release

Chicago, IL – November 13, 2026 – Zacks.com announces the list of stocks featured in the Analyst Blog. Every day the Zacks Equity Research analysts discuss the latest news and events impacting stocks and the financial markets. Stocks recently featured in the blog include: Tesla TSLA, SpaceX SPCX and Ford F.

Here are highlights from Thursday's Analyst Blog:

Tesla to Wind Down Cybertruck - Can Cybercab Justify the Shift?

Tesla is making room for a different future at its Gigafactory Texas plant. The company is expected to bring Cybertruck production to a close in fall 2027, with the factory space eventually being used to build Cybercab, its driverless vehicle. The move comes as the electric pickup struggled to attract mass-market buyers and fell short of the sales volumes Elon Musk once envisioned.

This is not simply a decision to stop making an underperforming model. It reflects Tesla's growing preference for autonomy and robotics over some parts of its traditional vehicle business. The bigger question is whether these newer ambitions can generate enough business for the company.

Cybertruck Struggles to Meet Its Sales Ambitions

When Tesla unveiled the Cybertruck, Musk set an ambitious target of selling 250,000 units annually. Its unconventional design attracted plenty of attention, but the initial excitement did not translate into sustained demand.

Per CNBC, Cox Automotive estimated that Tesla sold just 20,237 Cybertrucks in the United States in 2025, down 48% from 38,965 in 2024. Several recalls have added to the model's challenges, while its high price has limited its appeal to a wider pool of buyers.

Production capacity further highlights the mismatch. Tesla had installed capacity to produce more than 125,000 Cybertrucks annually, but the vehicle was selling at a pace of roughly 30,000 units a year before the wind-down announcement last Friday. That leaves considerable manufacturing capacity underutilized.

Tesla has now stopped accepting orders for the Premium AWD version, leaving the Cyberbeast as the only available configuration. Its price has increased by $7,500 to $109,990. Buyers placing orders now are being given delivery estimates between March and June 2027. Musk has said production will continue until the end of summer 2027 to work through the remaining backlog.

An interesting part of the sales story is SpaceX . Musk's aerospace, communications and AI company purchased $131 million worth of Cybertrucks last year at Tesla's suggested retail price, according to a SpaceX financial filing. While these purchases contributed to demand, they also raise questions about how much of the Cybertruck's sales momentum came from buyers outside the broader retail market.

Story Continues

Tesla is not alone in discovering how difficult it is to make electric pickups profitable. Ford , which operates in the highly profitable U.S. pickup market, has also struggled to make its electric F-150 Lightning commercially viable and has decided to discontinue the model. Ford continues to report losses in its EV business but is working on a more affordable electric pickup. This highlights the difficulty of building a profitable electric truck business, even for established automakers with strong pickup franchises.

Cybercab and Optimus Become Tesla's Priorities

The factory space freed up by the Cybertruck's departure is expected to support Cybercab manufacturing. Cybercab is designed as a two-seat, fully autonomous vehicle without a steering wheel or pedals.

Musk sees Cybercab as central to Tesla's transportation-as-a-service strategy, in which autonomous vehicles could generate revenues by providing paid rides rather than relying solely on individual vehicle sales. If successful, this model could create recurring revenue opportunities and change how Tesla generates returns from its vehicle fleet.

But the economics are still a big question mark. Tesla must show that its technology can handle driverless operations reliably, win the necessary regulatory permissions and attract enough customers to support a commercially viable service. Manufacturing Cybercab at scale will matter only if the company can put those vehicles to productive use and earn attractive returns from them.

Tesla's focus on robotics is also increasing. The company has repurposed the Model S and Model X production lines at its Fremont factory to scale production of Optimus, its humanoid robot. Tesla ended Model S and Model X production in spring, citing its growing focus on autonomy. The Cybertruck wind-down further reinforces this strategic shift away from some of its existing vehicle programs.

Final Thoughts

Tesla's decision to wind down Cybertruck production makes sense given the truck's weak sales, underutilized capacity and limited progress toward its original volume ambitions. Cybercab has the potential to open up a new market for Tesla, but the company is yet to prove that its autonomous ride-hailing model can work at scale. Optimus is an even longer-term opportunity, with commercial returns still to be demonstrated.

Cybercab may eventually make the shift worthwhile, but until Tesla proves that driverless rides can become a profitable business, the opportunity remains more promise than payoff.

The Zacks Rundown on Tesla

Shares of Tesla have gained 15% over the past three months compared with the industry's growth of 8%.

From a valuation standpoint, TSLA trades at a forward price-to-sales ratio of 13.13, way above the industry. It carries a Value Score of F.

news.Content:
【財訊快報／黃啟乙】台股週五開盤不久即大漲逾千點，但上午10點過後賣壓逐漸湧現，午間指數漲幅明顯收斂，終場上漲583.25點，以43,675.12點作收，成交量略為縮減至約9,162億元，顯示市場追價力道仍有待觀察。　　盤面上，ASIC相關族群成為短線焦點，聯發科(2454)、創意(3443)及世芯-KY(3661)等指標股，雖然午後陸續打開漲停板，但整體股價仍維持強勢型態，顯示資金對自研AI晶片及ASIC產業趨勢的認同度仍高。因此，台股短線能否進一步向上攻堅，可先觀察聯發科、創意及世芯-KY等指標股能否延續強勢，並帶動相關族群接棒表態。

此外，隨著第三季財報陸續公布，市場不少個股不僅本益比具吸引力，營收、業績及獲利更同步創高，股價漸獲投資人青睞，豐達科(3004)便是其中代表。豐達科週五股價重新站回各條均線之上，技術面已有轉強跡象，若後續成交量能進一步放大，將有助於股價延續反彈，朝更高位置挑戰。

news.Title: 《美股主題週報》自動化投資顧問—SCHW、JPM、MS
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-13 14:23:17 數位內容中心 發佈

Charles Schwab（SCHW.US）

近期Charles Schwab在Schwab Advisor Center擴大推出面向註冊投資顧問（RIA）的AI工具，覆蓋超過16,000家顧問公司，並提供每家4,800美元Claude使用抵用額。這顯示其數位財富管理重點正從投組服務延伸到前線顧問工作流程。

Morgan Stanley（MS.US）

近期Morgan Stanley出現攔截客戶AI Agent未經授權自動資金劃轉的案例，並已從試點進入實際使用DTCC代幣化服務。這反映其財富管理平台同步強化AI操作風控與數位資產處理能力，而非只聚焦投資建議功能。

J.P. Morgan Wealth Management（JPM.US）

近期J.P. Morgan Wealth Management職缺明確揭露，其平台同時提供自助投資、自動化投資與全服務顧問關係，業務規模約4,000億美元資產管理規模（AUM），配置約4,000名顧問。這顯示其主軸仍是實體通路結合數位投資工具的混合式服務。

Wealthfront（WLTH.US）

近期Wealthfront在市場單日重挫期間，揭露其自動化稅損收割為客戶收割7.4百萬美元稅務虧損，並稱截至2026年6月30日累計估計已節省13億美元稅款。這延續其以0.25%費率搭配稅務優化的產品主軸。

Goldman Sachs（GS.US）

近期Goldman Sachs成立新的私人投資平台，整合既有另類投資業務，並新增2個團隊，擴大高淨值客戶與家族辦公室參與未上市公司直接投資及二級市場交易的管道。這顯示平台化布局正向另類資產分銷延伸。

news.Title: ASIC軍團點火！聯發科、創意噴漲停 台股收漲583點
news.Content:
台股今（13）日開高震盪，盤中一度大漲逾1300點，不過後續漲勢收斂，44000點得而復失，尾盤以43675點作收，上漲583點，漲幅1.35%，成交量來到9162億元，資金聚焦於Google概念股、台塑四寶等。

權值股部分，台積電來到2350元，上漲10元，漲幅0.43%，聯發科則受惠於Google推出新款TPU，早盤一度攻上漲停價4235元，不過午盤後漲停打開，尾盤收4120元，上漲270元，漲幅7.01%，緯穎也有逾5%的漲幅。

進一步觀察Google概念股，智原收漲停，創意、世芯-KY、M31則漲停打開，尾盤收漲逾8~9%，華通則漲勢大幅收斂，尾盤收漲逾4%。

台塑四寶也有不錯的表現，台塑上漲逾4%，收71.1元，台塑化來到92.5元，上漲2.55%，台化來到75元，上漲5.34%，南亞則來到304元，上漲3.75%。

（封面圖／東森新聞）

news.Title: 《美股法說》應材營收創高 AI晶片設備需求旺
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-13 14:04:37 數位內容中心 發佈

Applied Materials（AMAT.US）公布 2026 財年第四季與全年成績，全年營收達 344 億美元，創歷史新高；單季營收 104 億美元，較上季季增 14%，非 GAAP 每股盈餘為 $4.16，較上季成長 19%，並帶動全年非 GAAP 基本每股盈餘年增 37% 至 $12.89。公司同時報告毛利率持續擴張，財年毛利率達 50.1%，單季毛利率為 50.6%。

營運面，Applied 在先進製程關鍵領域維持市占領先，並強調 Epic 平台與 AIX 服務在材料、製程整合與良率提升上的核心角色；AIX 已連接超過 3.7 萬個腔體，年增逾 20%，宣布的 EPIC 夥伴增至 15 家，並在矽谷設立 Epic Center。資本與現金流面，2026 財年營運現金流 89 億美元，資本支出 27 億美元，自由現金流 62 億美元，全年對股東現金回饋逾 47 億美元，其中第四季回購 20 億美元、現金股息 4.21 億美元。

展望與比較方面，公司預告下一季（14 週）營收指引為 111 億美元 ±5 億美元，非 GAAP 每股盈餘指引 $4.35 ±$0.20，並預期非 GAAP 毛利率約 50.8%。管理層計畫自本季基礎在 2028 年將系統出貨量翻倍，且宣布連續第三季在工廠追蹤器上新增逾 10 個晶圓廠專案，顯示供應鏈與產能擴張節奏較上季更為積極；同時管理層指出 AGS 與半導體系統在本季均呈現兩位數的季增，毛利率各自較上季改善約 150 個基點，支撐未來資本回饋與再投資。

下季觀察重點為 1) Q1 指引實際落地情況與是否延續高毛利率與營業槓桿，2) AIX/EPIC 採用速度與新增夥伴能否助攻良率與出貨提前，3) 管理層就產能擴張（2028 年系統翻倍、2030 年製造與實驗室產能翻倍）之具體時程與供應鏈風險管控。

news.Title: 【台股盤後】週線終止連4黑　單週大漲3973.48點
news.Content:
（中央社記者張建中台北2026年11月13日電）台股今天震盪上漲583.25點，收在43675.12點，留下逾769點長上影線，成交值新台幣9162.55億元。台股週線終止連4黑，單週大漲3973.48點。

輝達（NVIDIA）執行長黃仁勳辭去執行長等職務，輝達主要晶片代工廠台積電 (2330) 今天股價並不受影響，上漲10元，收在2350元。

聯發科 (2454) 因與Google合作開發張量處理單元（TPU），市場看好可望在輝達高層異動中受惠，股價上漲270元，漲幅逾7%。其餘電子權值股日月光投控 (3711) 和台光電 (2383) 等也紛紛收漲，整體電子類股指數上漲1.2%。

近期資安事件頻傳，市場資金湧入資服族群，包括東捷資訊 (6697) 、仁大資訊 (7767) 等多檔強攻漲停。

金融股也有不錯表現，，隨著富邦金 (2881) 、國泰金 (2882) 和中信金 (2891) 揚升，類股指數上漲2.16%。

傳統產業股多數收漲，玻璃類股指數上漲4%，塑膠類股指數上漲3.85%，紡織、機電、營建、航運和觀光類股指數上漲逾1%，造紙和鋼鐵類股表現相對弱勢，類股指數下挫逾1%。

高價股方面，創意 (3443) 上揚750元，收在8610元，超越川湖 (2059) 的7880元，登上台股股后，僅次於股王信驊 (5274) 的12000元。隨著金像電 (2368) 股價重登1000元大關之上，台股千金股陣容增至39千金。

兆豐國際投顧副總經理黃國偉表示，台股11月12日震盪殺低，收盤下挫1165.28點，主要是因為輝達傳出將召開董事會決定黃仁勳去留，投資人採取規避風險措施所致。

黃國偉說，黃仁勳辭去輝達執行長等職務，市場評估短期對於AI產業和台灣產業鏈影響有限，今天以利空出盡反應，展開反彈，台股後續應留意上檔均線反壓。

news.Title: 《美股法說》YETI下修財測 估消費需求更趨謹慎
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-13 14:03:26 數位內容中心 發佈

YETI Holdings（YETI.US）第三季營運呈現「穩中有進」，公司公布調整後營收約 5.18 億美元、調整後每股稀釋盈餘 0.91 美元；管理層同時將 2026 年度調整後營收成長預估自先前的 7–8% 下修至約 6%，反映對消費需求趨勢的更審慎看法。品牌行銷回歸線性電視並擴大活動佈局，管理層稱此舉提升年輕族群、女性與運動迷等族群的品牌搜尋與廣告記憶度。

本季營收動能由飲品杯類帶動，drinkware 成長 8% 至約 2.84 億美元，coolers & equipment 成長 4% 至約 2.24 億美元；通路方面 wholesale 增長 19% 至約 2.37 億美元，DTC 則下滑 3% 至約 2.81 億美元。調整後毛利約 3.05 億美元，毛利率擴張 310 個基點至 59%，調整後營業利益約 9,000 萬美元，營業利益率擴張至 17.4%；現金約 7,400 萬美元、庫存約 3.94 億美元，第三季購回自家股票約 2,000 萬美元，年初至今合計約 1.5 億美元，資本配置維持積極。

相較前一季，管理層已從較寬鬆的年度營收財測轉為更保守的約 6% 成長，並指出第 53 週比較帶來約 100 個基點的成長阻力；同時管理層也預期第三季在美國與加拿大觀察到的需求不均情況將延續到第四季，展望短期仍偏謹慎。公司強調將以品牌與產品創新為攻勢，並透過精準行銷與費用紀律保護利潤，國際擴張（日本、韓國、英國等）表現強勁但對加拿大持保留態度。

下季觀察重點為：一、假期檔期執行是否能在有限需求下維持品質性成長並守住毛利率；二、wholesale 與 DTC 的通路動態是否會延續本季分化；三、管理層下修後的全年財測能否在第四季回補差距，以及庫存與自由現金流變化對資本回購與投資的影響。

news.Title: 《美股法說》Twist營收年增近三成 AI藥物研發動能強
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-13 14:00:51 數位內容中心 發佈

Twist Bioscience（TWST.US）宣布2026財年為其平台與製造基礎建設的關鍵年，第四季營收達1.266億美元，年增28%、季增7%，推動全年營收達4.594億美元，較2025財年成長22%。公司同時披露第四季毛利率53.1%、全年毛利率52.4%，顯示規模效應帶動獲利率改善。

營運端顯著擴充自動化與產能：全年出貨約130萬基因、第四季出貨401,000基因，年出貨量較去年增43%，內部使用基因量則超過翻倍；公司表示全部16台DNA writer啟動後每日產能將超過5,000萬片DNA。第四季DNA synthesis 與 protein solutions 營收合計6,100萬美元，年增33%、季增8%；NGS應用營收6,570萬美元，年增24%、季增6%；療法相關全年營收1.623億美元，年增47%，其中AI藥物發現達5,910萬美元，年增175%。經營費用（不含營收成本）第四季為9,170萬美元，全年為3.803億美元；調整後EBITDA第四季由負轉正，為正220萬美元，全年仍為負3,590萬美元。公司期末現金及短期投資5.82億美元，包含公開募股與ATM淨收益4.248億美元。

展望方面，管理層預期2027財年營收達5.5至5.6億美元，約較2026年成長21%，並指全年毛利率目標約52.5%至53.0%、預計全年調整後EBITDA為正；資本支出指引約7,500萬美元，為兩年投資計畫的一部分。就季度動向，管理層對2027財年第一季指引1.30至1.32億美元，較上季顯著成長且預期DNA synthesis & protein solutions 及NGS各自季比成長約25%。

下季觀察重點為新產能與自動化能否如期放量以支撐營收成長與毛利穩定、AI藥物發現營收能否維持高成長，以及資本支出投入對短期利用率與調整後EBITDA的影響。

news.Title: 〈台股盤後〉聯發科領軍ASIC族群點火 終場漲583點收43675點未能站回月線
news.Content:
電子權值股今(13)日大多走揚，加上ASIC族群在聯發科領軍下紛紛點火，低軌衛星族群同步上揚，帶動大盤今天盤中一度大漲超過1300點，最高衝上44489.48點，不過盤中漲幅收斂，終場漲583.25點或1.35%，收43675.12點，未能收復月線，成交量9100億元。

觀察電子權值股今天表現，台積電(2330-TW)漲10元或0.43%，收2350元，聯發科(2454-TW)雖漲停打開，仍大漲逾半根停板，鴻海(2317-TW)則小漲0.42%。另外，日月光(3711-TW)漲逾2%，聯電(2303-TW)漲0.5%，台達電(2308-TW)收平盤，廣達(2382-TW)則跌0.72%。

news.Title: 《美股法說》Ondas訂單強勁 擴大無人載具量產
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-13 13:58:05 數位內容中心 發佈

Ondas（ONDS.US）管理層公布第三季營收達約1.675億美元，較上季翻倍成長，較去年同期則增逾16倍；同時季末訂單餘額攀升至8.35億美元，較上季增加36%。公司並啟動多項併購與組織整合，擴張從完整自主系統至關鍵任務元件的能力，並對外提出2027年營收下限目標為至少11億美元，預期有機成長逾40%。

本季營運重點在於透過收購Design、CyberHawk及GATE等強化感測、彈性通訊、遠端操作與電子引信等技術，並成立ONDAS Land Systems整合五家地面系統公司。第三季毛利為3,650萬美元，調整後毛利率為34.8%，管理層指出毛利承壓主因為Precision Strike比重上升與生產擴充造成的暫時性效率不佳；營業費用由上季的1.99億美元增至2.26億美元，調整後現金營運費用也由8,880萬美元升至約1.19億美元。庫存自上季5,900萬美元增至1.11億美元以因應量產，調整後EBITDA本季虧損5,970萬美元，較上季擴大約1,340萬美元。

公司並報告第三季新增訂單約2.14億美元、前九月累計新訂單5.07億美元，且宣稱美國市場貢獻超過半數營收；管理層指出已識別約32.5億美元的地面系統潛在機會池（未加權），並將Ion Strike列為可量產化產品，計劃於2027年初達到每月數百件產能，並於2027年末朝每月數千件擴張。此外，管理層調整財務時程，預期營運平台在2026年第四季達到調整後EBITDA獲利，而公司整體調整後EBITDA獲利時點則提前至2027年第三季。

下季觀察重點為併購案（STEMe、ARON）能否順利完成並落實產能擴充、Ion Strike與Ultra等產品的量產節奏是否如期推進以轉化8.35億美元的訂單餘額，以及在量產放大下毛利率能否回升至更穩定水準。

news.Title: 《美股法說》Nebius營收飆逾五倍 估2027成長動能續強
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-13 13:56:22 數位內容中心 發佈

Nebius Group（NBIS.US）第三季交出創紀錄表現，單季營收達約9.74億美元，年增643%，同時調整後息稅折舊攤銷前利潤（adjusted EBITDA）達4.66億美元，調整後毛利率47.5%，顯示公司在企業與AI原生客戶需求擴張下獲利能力顯著提昇。

公司指出客戶正簽訂更長期且預付比重提高的合約，超過90%的第三季合約包含預付款，預付款加權平均比重較第二季約增加20個百分點，且預付款金額已覆蓋第三季新簽案背後超過100%的資本支出。單位合約金額也擴大，第三季每兆瓦合約價格超過2,500萬美元（較第二季的2,000–2,500萬美元提升），Nebius AI Cloud 本季調整後EBITDA率為53.2%，亦較上季的50%進一步改善。

公司表示持續以自有基地與少數共置構建容量，並同步投資容量、軟體平台與商務拓展；管理層將2026年資本支出上調至約270億美元（原區間200–250億美元），維持2026年集團調整後EBITDA率約40%的年度指引。對於2027年，管理層初步預估營收約1,200–1,300億美元，並規劃資本支出約400–450億美元，預期2027年第四季實現稅前損益平衡，且預計2027年有170–200億美元來自客戶預付款。

下季觀察重點包括公司能否如期將更多GW等級容量上線以支撐營收成長與成本下降、預付款及合約結構是否能維持高水準以資助大規模資本支出，以及自有場址比重提升是否繼續帶動單位利潤改善。

news.Title: 《美股法說》Intuitive Machines上修財測 推進登月與衛星任務
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-13 13:55:18 數位內容中心 發佈

Intuitive Machines（LUNR.US）公布2026財年第3季財報，單季營收達2.69 億美元，較上一季成長31%，並將全年營收展望上修至9.2–9.5 億美元。公司同時宣稱第三季調整後 EBITDA 為正800萬美元，續顯獲利趨勢改善。

本季營運層面，Intuitive Machines 完成多項合約定案與生產里程碑，包括基於 IM-300 的 AMDT-3 與 Hartford 國安任務、以及 NASA Earth Science 的 Eagle VisWare，並成功在軌交付 Sirius XM11（IM-1300 系列）。地面設施與任務備援亦有進展：收購 Goonhilly CompSat 已完成並展現域空監測能力，休士頓主站已完成主星座任務營運中心，且正在整合 Goonhilly 的運控中心，馬里蘭州備援中心在建。登月項目方面，IM3 登陸器完成 LOX-methane 引擎熱試，管理層表示端對端測試將於第一季內完成，目標維持 3–4 月發射時窗，並將 ALTUS-2 至 ALTUS-5 加速整合，計畫於 2028 年同乘 NASA 提供的 Falcon 9 發射。

財務面顯示季度毛利 6,900 萬美元、毛利率 26%，較去年同期顯著改善（前年同期毛利 600 萬美元、毛利率 11%），公司表示其中約1,900萬美元為一次性專案調整所致。期末現金為4.64 億美元，較 Q2 的3.67 億美元增加，營運活動本季淨創造現金6,600萬美元；資本支出為3,300萬美元，主因 ALTUS/NSMS 星座加速。第三季新接單與來自 Goonhilly 併購的 backlog 增補使得合約未履行金額達19 億美元，構成未來營收能見度。

下季觀察重點為：IM3 登陸器是否能如期完成首季端對端測試並進入3–4月發射時窗；ALTUS-2 至 ALTUS-5 的加速整合與 2028 年同發計畫能否維持進度；以及資本支出持續偏高對 2027 年現金流與獲利彈性的影響。

news.Title: 《美股法說》Belite Bio新藥獲優先審查 加速臨床試驗與給付布局
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-13 13:54:04 數位內容中心 發佈

Belite Bio（BLTE.US）本季宣布其治療 Stargardt 病的 NDA 已獲 FDA 受理並列為優先審查，目標決策日定為 2037 年 2 月 12 日；公司期末現金與等同項下為 7.74 億美元，本季非 GAAP 研發支出為 1,470 萬美元、GAAP 營業暨研發以外之銷管費為 2,140 萬美元。管理層強調資金充裕，足以支撐在潛在核准情況下的商業化準備與產品線推進。

營運面上，公司同時在日本提出 JNDA 以及於英國、瑞士與新加坡透過 Access Consortium 申請授權，並完成從 NASDAQ Capital Market 到 NASDAQ Global Select Market 的上櫃升格，且已開始與給付方與 PBM 接觸以促進未來擴大覆蓋。臨床規劃方面，管理層確認本季在英國多個試驗點啟動一項 12 歲以下之兒童 PIP 研究（在獲 IRB 正面評估後於年底前啟動），並計畫對 GA 研究進行中期分析但尚未定案分析設計。

相較於前一季，公司現金從上季的 7.80 億美元小幅降至本季 7.74 億美元；且相較於前一季尚未完成的資本市場定位，本季已完成 NASDAQ 升格並加速給付方接觸布建。財務面顯示營運支出拉高：本季非 GAAP 淨損為 2,430 萬美元，較去年同期擴大，管理層表示支出增加主要來自 API/DP 製造、顧問費與專業服務費用，但仍認為現金能支援接下來的商業化準備工作，前提為監管結果正面。

下季觀察重點包括 FDA 對 NDA 的最終裁定進程與 2 月 PDUFA 日期前的監管互動、UK 兒童 PIP 試驗的啟動與進度，以及公司與給付方的覆蓋談判能否為潛在上市建立有利的支付條件。

news.Title: 《美股法說》思科上修全年財測 AI交換器訂單續增
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-13 13:53:18 數位內容中心 發佈

Cisco（CSCO.US）在2027會計年度第1季交出強勁表現，單季營收達185億美元，年增24%；非GAAP每股盈餘為$1.40，年增40%，公司指出產品需求為主要推手。管理層同時上調全年財測，將2027財年營收區間調升至748–758億美元，並將非GAAP每股盈餘目標上修至$5.47–5.53。

本季營運面顯示需求廣泛且以產品為核心：產品營收為147億美元，年增32%，產品訂單年增21%，其中Networking產品訂單成長28%，為連續第九季兩位數成長；Nexus針對AI的資料中心交換器年增47%，且服務供應商與雲端訂單年增47%。毛利率方面，總非GAAP毛利率為65.6%，較去年同期下滑250個基點，主要受硬體比重提升與記憶體成本上升影響；另一方面，服務毛利率上升220個基點至72.9%。

與上一季相比，本季在幾項關鍵指標出現分化：單季營收從上一季的173億美元進一步上升至185億美元，且非GAAP每股盈餘由上一季的$1.22提升至$1.40；但產品訂單年增率由前一季的35%降至本季21%，而網路產品訂單從上季約40%回落至28%。展望上，管理層已較上季保守或積極調整財測，將FY27 AI Hyperscale營收占比預估由6%提升至12%，並提高全年營收與每股盈餘指引，反映對超大規模客戶需求加速的預期。

下季觀察重點包括：超大規模（hyperscaler）與AI基礎設施訂單能否持續放大並支撐更高的硬體比重；記憶體與硬體成本走勢對產品毛利率的影響；以及管理層能否在Q2實現預期的36–37%非GAAP營業利益率與$1.34–1.36的每股盈餘目標。

news.Title: 台股收盤／聯發科、創意領軍強彈！台股上漲583點　資安股勁揚穩盤
news.Content:
美股四大指數週四（12日）全面收黑，台股今（13）日卻展現強勁反彈氣勢，早盤開高後一度衝高，隨後漲幅逐步收斂，加權指數終場上漲583.25點，收在43675.12點，漲幅1.35%，成交金額達9162.55億元；代表中小型股的櫃買指數同步走揚，終場上漲6.68點，收在342.41點，漲幅1.99%，成交金額2208.12億元。

美股四大指數收黑　台股逆勢反彈583點

美股主要指數週四（12日）全數收低，輝達宣布執行長黃仁勳請辭，股價下跌4.34%，單日市值蒸發約1821億美元，衝擊市場信心。不過，半導體股走勢呈現分歧，輝達競爭對手超微（AMD）與博通（AVGO）雙雙逆勢大漲逾5%，顯示晶片股仍有資金進駐。另一方面，中概股同步走弱，那斯達克金龍中國指數下滑超過3%，美股市場多空交錯。

儘管美股全面收低，台股今日仍展現反彈動能，加權指數早盤迅速走高，盤中一度擴大漲勢，但隨著部分個股漲幅收斂，指數自高檔回落，午盤過後維持震盪整理，終場仍成功上漲583.25點。觀察盤面，上市股票上漲家數983家、下跌293家，漲停28家、跌停3家，顯示多方仍占上風。

成交金額方面，上市市場達9162.55億元，櫃買市場2208.12億元，兩市合計成交金額達1兆1370.67億元，反映市場交投熱絡，資金積極進行持股調整與布局。權王台積電（2330）上漲10元，收在2350元，聯發科（2454）大漲270元，創意（3443）勁揚750元，成為盤面吸睛焦點，顯示市場資金持續在電子權值股與高價股間輪動。

倫元投顧陳學進分析師認為，隨著輝達執行長黃仁勳昨日爆出請辭消息，在黃仁勳桃色風波利空可望出盡、以及聯發科、創意、世芯-KY等ASIC概念股強勢亮燈漲停的帶動下，盤中指數一度大漲1397點、上探至44489點；不過，由於美AI監管政策不確定性未除，外資期貨空單居高不下，且昨日外資現貨賣超雖急速縮減至6.85億元，但整體心態仍是呈現相對謹慎保守，加上目前月線位於44650點向下、季線位於46230點向下，仍有待時間化解，就過往經驗，台股歷經24.3%恐慌回檔修正之後，基本上，已具備中長期布局的價值；且下檔於11/9日止跌長紅K棒40347~41661點區間附近有撐，配合年底集團與法人作帳行情展開，AI鏈重新成為買盤關注指標，包括ASIC設計、高階玻纖布、高階PCB暨鑽孔機、CPO光通訊、板卡、測試介面等族群皆同步走揚，躍居盤面焦點；再者，輝達跌倒，超微、谷歌與博通等撿到槍，ASIC設計、高階玻纖布、高階PCB暨鑽孔機、以及相關超微與谷歌概念股等將可望接棒擔綱盤面主軸，另外，駭客加速攻擊，催生企業快速拉高IT預算及資安人員配置，法人看好資安監控、零信任架構、AI威脅偵測及資安委外服務需求，國內資安及資訊服務業者包括大世科、驊宏資、華經、資通、安碁資、中華資安、零壹、東捷資訊等，有望迎來新商機，逢低亦是值得留意。

聯發科狂飆270元　創意大漲750元成焦點

觀察成交值較大的個股，台積電（2330）持續扮演穩盤角色，終場上漲10元，收在2350元，漲幅0.43%，雖然漲幅不大，仍對大盤形成支撐。聯發科（2454）表現格外亮眼，股價大漲270元，收在4120元，漲幅達7.01%，成為電子權值股反彈的重要指標。<

news.Title: 台股漲勢砍半收盤漲583點！黃仁勳閃辭ASIC撿槍 創意登上股后
news.Content:
輝達（NVIDIA）執行長黃仁勳因接連爆出婚外情請辭，但市場以利空出盡解讀，台股今日一度大漲逾1200點，攻上44489.48點，但面臨月線反壓，加上適逢13日星期五，部分投資人先行賣出，指數漲幅收斂，台股終場漲583.25點，以43675.12點作收，成交量9163億。

全球AI晶片供應鏈恐震盪，市場看好ASIC陣營將受惠，激勵聯發科股價一度強攻漲停價4235元，收盤漲7.01%，世芯-KY漲逾9%，創意一度攻漲停8645元登上新股后，一舉超越川湖。台積電扮演穩盤角色，收盤漲0.43%。散熱概念股表現亮眼，奇鋐逼近漲停。

摩爾證券投顧分析師鐘崑禎表示，昨晚美股資金全數轉往AMD、AVGO，代表市場沒有因輝達事件，而對整個AI產業失去信心，不過是換個方向，AI前景仍看好。此外，明年2027是ASIC元年，ASIC需求會大於GPU，本次輝達事件將加速ASIC發展，聯發科、世芯-KY等將受惠。

台股昨日大跌1165.28點，收在43,091.87點，成交金額1兆132.93億元。當日外資現貨小幅賣超6.85億元合計，三大法人買超51.6億元。

news.Title: Cisco (CSCO) Q1 2027 Earnings Call Transcript
news.Content:
Image source: The Motley Fool.

DATE

Thursday, Nov. 12, 2026

CALL PARTICIPANTS

Head of Investor Relations - Ahmed Sami Badri

Chair and Chief Executive Officer - Charles Robbins

Chief Financial Officer - Mark Patterson

Full Conference Call Transcript

Operator: Welcome to Cisco's First Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Financial Results Conference Call. At the request of Cisco, today's conference is being recorded. If you have any objections, you may disconnect. Now I would like to introduce Sami Badri, Head of Investor Relations. Sir, you may begin.

Ahmed Sami Badri: Good afternoon, everyone. This is Sami Badri, Cisco's Head of Investor Relations, and I'm joined by Chuck Robbins, our Chair and CEO; and Mark Patterson, our CFO. Cisco's earnings press release and supplemental information, including GAAP to non-GAAP reconciliations are available on our Investor Relations website. Today's call is also being live streamed on YouTube, LinkedIn and X. Following this call, we will also make the recorded webcast and slides available on the website. Throughout today's call, we'll be referencing both GAAP and non-GAAP financial results. We will discuss product results in terms of revenue and geographic and customer results in terms of product orders, unless stated otherwise. All comparisons will be made on a year-on-year basis, unless stated otherwise.

Please note that our discussion today will include forward-looking statements, including our guidance for the second quarter and fiscal year 2027. These statements are subject to risks and uncertainties detailed in our SEC filings, particularly our most recent 10-K report, which identify important risk factors that could cause actual results to differ materially from those contained in our forward-looking statements. With respect to guidance, please also see the slides and press release that accompany this call for further details. Cisco will not comment on its financial guidance during the quarter unless it is done through an explicit public disclosure. Now I'll turn it over to Chuck.

Charles Robbins: Thanks, Sami, and thank you all for joining us today. I'm pleased to report that Cisco delivered an impressive start to fiscal '27. We're executing against our strategy, and seeing growing demand as customers invest in the infrastructure they need for the AI or SI era. What gives me the greatest confidence is not just the results we're seeing today but also the opportunities we see ahead. In Q1, we delivered record quarterly revenue of $18.5 billion, up 24% year-over-year and record non-GAAP earnings per share of $1.40, up 40% year-over-year. These are our strongest top and bottom line growth rates in over 15 years.

Story Continues

We are demonstrating strong operating leverage and enhanced earnings power with earnings growing faster than revenue. As a result of this strong performance, we are significantly increasing our fiscal year '27 guidance, which Mark will cover shortly. Our profitable growth generates robust cash flows and fuels consistent capital returns to our shareholders. In Q1, we returned $3.7 billion in value through dividends and share repurchases, representing 95% of free cash flow. Our strong start to fiscal year '27 demonstrates the criticality of networking and security together as agentic AI accelerates. As customers look to manage increasing traffic costs and threats, they are turning to Cisco for our networking expertise, security and observability solutions and services.

They trust us to help scale, secure and optimize their environments for the agentic AI era ahead. The depth and breadth of our portfolio enables us to support our customers however they choose to deploy AI, whether in the public cloud, through neoclouds or sovereign clouds, on-premise, or at the edge. We believe we are still early in the networking super cycle driven by AI deployments with enterprise adoption just beginning. In Q1, we saw strong demand with total product orders growing 21% year-over-year on top of 13% growth a year ago. We saw strong demand excluding hyperscalers with product orders up 14% year-over-year on top of 9% growth a year ago.

We also saw double-digit growth across all geographies and customer markets. Enterprise product orders in Q1 were up 15% year-over-year on top of 4% growth a year ago with double-digit growth across all geographies and in networking and security. Public sector orders were up 13% year-over-year on top of 12% growth a year ago. We saw double-digit public sector growth in the Americas and APJC as well as in networking, security and collaboration. Product orders from service provider and cloud customers continue to be broad-based, growing 47% year-over-year. This is on top of 44% growth a year ago with triple-digit growth in APJC and double-digit growth in the Americas and EMEA.

We continue to see healthy demand from telcos with orders up approximately 20% year-over-year in Q1 on top of 24% growth a year ago. Turning to demand across our product categories. Networking product orders grew 28% in Q1, delivering our 9th consecutive quarter of double-digit growth. In fact, we saw double-digit growth across every product family, service provider routing, compute, enterprise routing, wireless, data center switching and campus switching. These broad-based results support our view that we are in the early stages of a multiyear, multibillion-dollar networking super cycle, as I referenced earlier, and we are executing with focus and urgency to capture this incremental opportunity.

Overall, our hyperscaler business continues to show strong momentum with AI infrastructure revenue projected to grow to $9 billion in fiscal year '27, more than double fiscal year '26 levels. Hyperscalers are now deploying our scale across networking architecture and production environments as they extend coordinated AI workloads across data centers. This architecture combines our Silicon One P200 deep-buffered systems, market-leading Acacia coherent optics and open line systems with multi-rail optical systems coming soon. Together, these products provide a single unified compute fabric with deep programmability and embedded security. In Q1, we secured 3 new AI design wins, 2 were for our P200 powered systems and data center interconnect and scale across use cases.

The third was for 1.6 Terabit Optics for scale-out use case. In addition to hyperscaler demand, we saw accelerated growth in AI infrastructure orders from neocloud, sovereign and enterprise customers in Q1, with Nexus data center switches tagged for AI deployments up 47% year-over-year. During the quarter, we announced a new partnership with Supermicro, which expands our Secure AI factory with NVIDIA. By integrating Supermicro's high-density, liquid and air cooled compute into an NVIDIA cloud partner-compliant full stack architecture, we're delivering more efficient end-to-end infrastructure for massive AI workloads. As agentic AI expands, security threats have become more complex and conversations around sovereignty are intensifying.

Our focus is delivering trusted sovereign solutions to help customers scale their data center build-outs with confidence. During the quarter, together with AMD and HUMAIN, we announced that AMD GPU-based AI infrastructure built on Silicon One based systems is now in production in Saudi Arabia. This enables HUMAIN to offer GPU as a service across training and inference use cases. To meet our customers' evolving needs, we also introduced our Sovereign Critical Infrastructure portfolio in Europe a year ago. This portfolio spans networking, security, compute, collaboration and observability and can be configured for on-premise, air-gapped environments. In Q1, we expanded to Canada with additional countries to follow, giving government agencies and critical infrastructure providers more control, choice, security and resilience.

Customers are also focused on modernizing their workplaces for humans and agents. We continue to see robust demand for our campus networking solutions in Q1 with 14% year-over-year growth in product orders. Our next-generation portfolio continues to ramp faster than prior product launches and we believe we are still very early in this refresh cycle. Orders for our industrial IoT portfolio grew approximately 50% year-over-year in Q1 and have now grown at double-digit rates for 10 consecutive quarters. Now shifting to security. Orders excluding Splunk were up in the mid-teens. Within our security platform, orders for firewalls grew over 30% for the third consecutive quarter.

Cisco AI Defense is helping customers guard against unmanaged AI use across the enterprise and is protecting more than 2 trillion tokens per month. Our work with Workday Agent Passport, ServiceNow and DefenseClaw with NVIDIA OpenShell demonstrates how we're expanding our ecosystem and building trust into the use of agents in daily operations. Earlier this week, we announced that we are integrating Anthropic's Claude Mythos cybersecurity model into Cisco AI Defense for adaptive AI red teaming. This provides automated, continuous testing across enterprise systems, empowering defenders to stress test AI systems with frontier adversary reasoning. Turning to Splunk. The platform is helping solve some of the most pressing challenge organizations face in the AI era.

A Splunk study found that urgency to deploy agents is outpacing enterprise's ability to monitor and secure them. With Splunk, we deliver a common data platform that enables customers to monitor and enforce guardrails on agent behavior while also helping them understand and manage tokenomics. This gives them greater confidence and predictability as they look to optimize both the business value and the cost of AI. In collaboration with a leading hyperscaler, Splunk is exploring how AI agents can help security teams investigate threats and coordinate responses more efficiently while keeping analysts in control. This builds on our strategy to strengthen secure operations as threats grow more complex. We'll have more to share later this month.

Now on to our innovation. We are focused on 4 often overlapping objectives: number one, simplifying network operations; number two, scaling infrastructure for agentic AI; number three, reimagining security and trust for agentic AI; and four, delivering intelligent workplace experiences. Last quarter, we highlighted Cisco Cloud Control as a breakthrough in simplifying operations. Since launch, more than 6,000 customers have signed up and can increase productivity by accessing multiple Cisco and partner products through a single user interface. We are building integrations within the platform, including AI Canvas, Cisco IQ and the recently launched Cisco Model Foundry.

Cisco IQ now has more than 17,000 customers, nearly doubling quarter-over-quarter and visibility into 23 million devices, accelerating vulnerability tracking from days to minutes. To scale infrastructure and improve the efficiency of AI factories, we recently announced plans with NVIDIA to develop the Ultra-Dense Small Form Factor Pluggable or USFP optical module. We expect USFP to deliver 4x the bandwidth density and 1.3x the power efficiency of current models. We also plan to create an open industry USFP specification to drive adoption. Our advances in security and trust are ongoing as we continue to introduce resilient and quantum-safe innovations.

We've expanded support for Live Protect across more of our campus networking portfolio, extended quantum readiness to WiFi 7 access points and plan to provide quantum-safe communications across most of our core portfolio by the end of this calendar year. We continue to develop intelligent workplace experiences recently launching Claude Managed Agents and Dialog, an agentic harness in Webex. Our teams continue to drive this work forward through innovation, productivity and commitment to leveraging AI tools. At the start of fiscal '27, we provided an AI agent for every employee. We expect to continue accelerating AI adoption, helping our employees execute. Now I'll turn it over to Mark for more detail on the quarter and our outlook.

Mark Patterson: Thanks, Chuck. VerifyMe Inc ( NASDAQ:VRME ) reported Q3 2026 total revenue of $7.4 million, with real-world asset (RWA) platform revenues contributing $6.4 million, or 86% of quarterly revenue, up from zero in Q3 2025.

Adjusted EBITDA was positive at $2.2 million for Q3 2026, excluding non-cash and non-recurring expenses.

VerifyMe Inc ( NASDAQ:VRME ) has approximately $21.2 million of transaction price allocated to unsatisfied performance obligations, providing visibility into future revenue.

The company announced strategic partnerships, including a deal with Meridian for up to $1 billion in tokenized Tesla Powerwall assets and a tokenized industrial IP deal with Beyond AI, positioning it in high-growth RWA tokenization markets.

Negative Points

VerifyMe Inc ( NASDAQ:VRME ) recorded a net loss of $10.2 million, or $0.93 per share, in Q3 2026, significantly impacted by $6 million in professional fees and $6.4 million in non-cash stock-based compensation.

Digital assets and capital markets revenue plummeted to $0.4 million in Q3 2026 from $20 million in Q3 2025, which was mostly one-time revenue from token generation events.

General and administrative expenses totaled $14.6 million, far exceeding revenue and highlighting cost inefficiencies despite being largely transaction-related.

Cash balance at September 30, 2026, was only $4.5 million, and the company needed a $3.5 million registered direct offering post-quarter to bolster liquidity.

Many announced deals are still in non-binding or definitive agreement phases, with capital formation underway, creating execution risk and uncertainty around timing of revenue recognition.

Q : Given just over $7 million of revenue, gross margin and adjusted EBITDA margin were strong out of the gate. Are these margin levels sustainable, and is there more upside? A : CFO Gerard Hernandez said the RWA business combines specialized structuring, implementation, and tokenized services with ongoing platform and servicing fees. Initial engagements establish the infrastructure, and recurring revenues build on that foundation with relatively limited incremental delivery costs. He expects this combination of reasonable technology costs, specialized expertise, and recurring fees to support attractive margins and additional operating leverage, with further upside as the business scales. (CFO Gerard Hernandez)

Q : What drove the third quarter revenue mix, and how much of it came from the RWA business? A : CFO Gerard Hernandez reported total Q3 2026 revenue of $7.4 million, of which RWA platform revenues contributed $6.4 million, or approximately 86%. There was no RWA revenue in Q3 2025, as the ramp-up only began in early 2026. For the first nine months of 2026, RWA revenue reached $9.1 million. These items drove a net loss of $10.2 million, or $0.93 per share. Q : What is the company's liquidity position and visibility into future revenue? Q : What is the status of the Meridian partnership involving Tesla Powerwalls? A : President Ross McMeekin described it as one of the largest tokenized projects in the world, using existing homes and commercial buildings with existing infrastructure plus solar to generate power for AI. news.Title: Cisco Systems Inc (CSCO) (Q1 2027) Earnings Call Highlights: Record Revenue and EPS Growth ...
news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

Revenue: Record quarterly revenue of $18.5 billion, up 24% year over year; strongest top-line growth in over 15 years.

Non-GAAP EPS: Record $1.40, up 40% year over year; strongest bottom-line growth in over 15 years.

Non-GAAP Operating Margin: 37.8%, reflecting continued operating leverage.

Non-GAAP Gross Margin: 65.6%, slightly above midpoint of guidance; down 250 basis points year over year on higher hardware mix.

Product Revenue: $14.7 billion, up 32% year over year.

Services Revenue: $3.9 billion, up 1% year over year.

Networking Revenue: Up 43% year over year, led by triple-digit AI infrastructure growth and double-digit data-center switching and Campus Networking growth.

Security Revenue: Up 7%, reflecting growth in Splunk, Network Security, and SASE.

Collaboration Revenue: Up 8%, with double-digit growth in devices and growth in contact center.

Product Gross Margin (non-GAAP): 63.7%, down 350 basis points, driven by higher hardware mix and elevated memory costs.

Services Gross Margin (non-GAAP): 72.9%, up 220 basis points.

Product Orders: Up 21% year over year; Americas up 18%, EMEA up 12%, APJC up 57%.

RPO: Total $46.2 billion, up 8%; Product RPO up 7%.

ARR: Total $32.7 billion, up 4%; Product ARR up 4%.

Software Revenue: $6.1 billion, up 8%; subscription revenue 44% of total revenue.

Operating Cash Flow: $4.4 billion, up 36%.

Cash & Investments: $15.8 billion in total cash, cash equivalents, and investments.

Capital Returns: $3.7 billion returned to shareholders ($1.7 billion dividends, $2 billion share repurchases), representing 95% of free cash flow; $6.1 billion remaining under repurchase program.

Non-GAAP Tax Rate: 18.5% for the quarter.

AI Infrastructure Revenue: Projected to grow to $9 billion in FY27, more than double FY26 levels; expected to represent 12% of total revenue in FY27, up from 6% in FY26.

Headcount: Total headcount declined by a low-single-digit percentage; expected revenue per employee up approximately 19% based on updated FY27 guidance.

Q2 Guidance: Revenue of $18.0$18.2 billion; non-GAAP gross margin 65%66%; non-GAAP operating margin 36%37%; non-GAAP EPS $1.34$1.36.

FY27 Guidance: Revenue of $74.8$75.8 billion; non-GAAP EPS of $5.47$5.53; operating margin expected to rise to 36% from 34.8% in FY26.

Warning! GuruFocus has detected 4 Warning Signs with CSCO.

Is CSCO fairly valued? Test your thesis with our free DCF calculator.

Release Date: November 12, 2026

For the complete transcript of the earnings call, please refer to the full earnings call transcript .

Story Continues

Positive Points

Cisco Systems Inc ( NASDAQ:CSCO ) delivered record quarterly revenue of $18.5 billion, up 24% year over year, and record non-GAAP EPS of $1.40, up 40% year over year, marking the strongest top- and bottom-line growth in over 15 years.

Total product orders grew 21% year over year, with double-digit growth across all geographies and customer markets, and product orders excluding hyperscalers grew 14%, indicating broad-based demand.

AI infrastructure revenue is projected to reach $9 billion in fiscal 2027, more than double fiscal 2026 levels, driven by 18 AI design wins in the last five quarters and strong hyperscaler demand.

Cisco Systems Inc ( NASDAQ:CSCO ) is seeing early stages of a multi-year networking super cycle, with campus networking orders up 14% year over year and only 9% of switching sold coming from the new portfolio, suggesting significant runway for growth.

Security orders excluding Splunk grew in the mid-teens, with firewall orders up over 30% for the third consecutive quarter, and the Zero Trust Secure Access portfolio added nearly 800 new customers in Q1, reaching 5,400 total.

Negative Points

Non-GAAP gross margin declined 250 basis points year over year to 65.6%, and product gross margin fell 350 basis points to 63.7%, due to higher hardware mix and elevated memory costs.

Services revenue grew only 1% year over year, lagging the overall company growth, and the services business is expected to improve gradually but remains a drag on total growth.

Cisco Systems Inc ( NASDAQ:CSCO ) faces continued component cost headwinds, particularly in memory and optics, which could pressure margins despite productivity improvements and price increases.

The company's AI revenue is heavily dependent on hyperscalers, which represented 12% of total revenue in fiscal 2027 guidance, up from 6% in fiscal 2026, creating concentration risk.

Supply chain constraints, especially in optics, could limit the company's ability to meet demand, although management expects improvement in the coming quarters.

Q & A Highlights

Q : You raised the fiscal '27 AI revenue target to $9 billion from $7.5 billion last quarter. What changed in 90 days, and is there any skew between Silicon One and Optics? A : CEO Chuck Robbins said the raise reflects "90 days more visibility" and continued strong order flow from hyperscalers rather than any single new factor. He noted the company had 18 AI design wins over the last five quarters, spanning scale-out systems, scale-across systems, and optics.

Q : What gives you confidence this is a multi-year networking super cycle rather than a peak in hyperscaler spending? A : CEO Chuck Robbins cited five multi-year, multi-billion-dollar drivers: hyperscale AI success (18 design wins in five quarters), the campus refresh (less than 10% through the transition), the post-Mythos security-driven upgrade opportunity, sovereign infrastructure demand, and accelerating hybrid data-center architectures among enterprises.

Q : How is supply holding up, particularly for silicon and memory, and what is driving gross margins holding up better than expected? A : CFO Mark Patterson said the company feels "really good" about supply, having leveraged its balance sheet into long-term strategic agreements, including a new multi-year memory deal this quarter. Optics is the tightest area but should improve next quarter. On margins, component-cost headwinds and hardware-heavy mix are being offset by productivity gains and scale, with full-year gross margin expected just shy of 65%.

Q : What is Cisco's exposure to neoclouds, and are they included in the AI revenue guidance? A : CEO Chuck Robbins characterized neocloud exposure as "relatively immaterial" and said Cisco has been conservative on their credit situations. He confirmed neoclouds are not included in the AI revenue guidance, which covers hyperscalers only.

Q : Where are we in the campus switching refresh cycle? A : CEO Chuck Robbins said only 9% of campus switching sold in the quarter came from the new portfolio, indicating the refresh is very early. He expects modernization demand to be driven by bandwidth needs for agentic AI rollouts and security upgrades in the post-Mythos era.

Q : Can you break down the raised fiscal '27 revenue guide between hyperscale and the core business? A : CFO Mark Patterson said of the 19% top-line growth guide, about 8 points come from hyperscale and 11 points from the ex-hyperscale core business. Of the $2.5 billion guidance raise, $1.5 billion is hyperscale and $1 billion is core, with strength broad-based across all Networking product families, regions, and customer markets.

Q : What is driving the strong Asia-Pacific orders, and where does the Security business and Splunk transition stand? A : CEO Chuck Robbins said APJC growth was balanced across segments enterprise up over 30%, public sector over 70%, and service provider/cloud in triple digits driven by sovereign demand, telco investment, and campus networking. On Security, core Cisco Security orders ex-Splunk grew 15%, the best in roughly three years, with firewalls up over 30% for a third straight quarter. CFO Mark Patterson said Security revenue of 7% was at or slightly above plan, with Splunk turning positive and improving through the year.

Q : How should we think about AI orders from hyperscalers, which appeared to tick down sequentially, and the pipeline for P200, G200, and G300? A : CEO Chuck Robbins said AI orders will remain lumpy and non-linear, which is why Cisco shifted to guiding on AI revenue. He noted P200 is performing well, G200 has many scale-out wins, G300 has begun shipping and is in labs, and the quarter included Cisco's first client-side 1.6-terabit optics win at a hyperscaler.

Q : What is the catalyst for Silicon One winning scale-across sockets, and how large could that market become? A : CEO Chuck Robbins attributed wins to performance, power consumption, and customer desire for silicon diversity. He said Cisco's study projects bandwidth requirements in this space will increase 14x, making the TAM large and growing. CFO Mark Patterson added that Cisco offers perhaps the most complete solution in the industry, combining silicon, Acacia optics, and multi-rail systems coming in calendar 2027.

Q : Can you update us on the Optics business run rate and timing for multi-rail and USFP products? A : CFO Mark Patterson said Optics had a $1 billion quarter last quarter and Q1 was a record first quarter, with demand increasing. CEO Chuck Robbins said the multi-rail line system arrives in the first few months of calendar 2027, while the USFP optical module is still a few years out.

Q : When will the Services business accelerate, and is there risk of a data-center build-out imbalance in 2028 and beyond? A : CFO Mark Patterson said Services turned positive this quarter and should continue improving, though ratable recognition and low hyperscaler attach temper the pace. CEO Chuck Robbins said he does not foresee resource constraints derailing the data-center build-out over the next two years, expecting geopolitical issues to be worked out given strong demand.

Q : Are you seeing any signs of AI data-center demand shifting outside the United States amid policy risk? A : CEO Chuck Robbins said Cisco has not seen demand shift abroad and does not expect it to, noting many states remain open to data centers and at least one governor has signaled support with community and energy-cost commitments. He said it is too important to the country and industry for data centers to be built outside the U.S.

Q : What is the status of Silicon One integration into the enterprise portfolio, and what does the $9 billion AI target imply for internal silicon mix? A : CEO Chuck Robbins said Silicon One is now being implemented in portions of the Enterprise Networking portfolio, with the fiscal 2029 full-conversion target on track. He noted that aside from optics, the hyperscaler AI business is 100% Silicon One-based platforms.

news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-13 12:52:02 陳怡潔 發佈

全球AI晶片龍頭輝達(NVIDIA)昨(12)日宣布，黃仁勳辭去總裁、執行長及董事職務，由財務長Colette Kress暫代執行長並續兼財務長；董事會啟動內外部接班人遴選，另由Harvey C. Jones出任公司首位董事會主席。野村投信今日表示，AI產業進入信心壓力測試，短線面臨領導權交接與估值衝擊，但是否演變為景氣反轉，仍取決於資本支出與訂單變化。信心衝擊不等於需求崩潰，尤其台灣具備供應鏈核心地位，難以被輕易取代，看好AI長期趨勢的投資人，可透過定期定額分散進場時點。後續則應追蹤新執行長人選、CUDA生態系、產品路線圖及客戶信心，以及輝達將於美國時間11月17日公布的第三季財報，資料中心營收、毛利率、產品供應、訂單與管理層指引，均為觀察重點。

野村投信指出，黃仁勳對技術創新與規格升級影響深遠，離任帶來的風險溢價上升，可能沿半導體、先進封裝，傳導至AI伺服器、散熱與電源族群，牽動台股權值股及投資情緒。不過，台灣完整供應鏈在先進製程、量產與系統整合上的優勢，難因單一企業人事異動而被取代。短期可觀察晶圓代工龍頭、先進封裝與AI伺服器族群是否同步波動，並對照訂單與出貨，辨別股價反應與基本面的差異。

從美股反應來看，部分競爭晶片股走強，顯示市場重新評估競爭格局；美債殖利率攀升與油價上漲引發的通膨疑慮，也加重科技股估值壓力。黃仁勳過往曾遊說美國政府放寬對中國晶片出口限制，後續美中科技政策值得關注。若科技限制擴大，促使業者分散零組件採購，具備替代技術與海外產能的台廠有望爭取轉單。

展望未來，野村投信表示，後續應追蹤新執行長人選、CUDA生態系、產品路線圖及客戶信心。輝達將於美國時間11月17日公布的第三季財報，資料中心營收、毛利率、產品供應、訂單與管理層指引，均為觀察重點。若AI硬體升級或資料中心建置節奏放緩，短期可能遞延供應鏈營收，但也可能讓大型雲端服務供應商(CSP)有時間消化既有投資，減輕現金流壓力，判斷AI景氣仍須觀察CSP資本支出計畫與輝達訂單有無下修，不宜將短期股價修正直接視為需求衰退。投資人可依風險承受度，以定期定額維持布局紀律，並持續檢視基本面與配置比重。

news.Title: 日勝生砸88億元開發高雄世運站！京站百貨將進駐 2030年完工
news.Content:
日勝生（2547）擴大布局南台灣！日勝生今（13）日宣布，攜手高雄市政府推動的「高雄R17世運站A5公辦都更案」正式動土，總投資金額超過88.5億元，預計4年後完工。全案將興建商辦、企業員工住宅及商業設施，瞄準台積電進駐楠梓帶動的半導體供應鏈需求，未來也將評估導入旗下京站百貨，擴大商場經營版圖。

日勝生表示，此次開發基地位於高雄捷運R17世運站東側，面積約4,200坪，規畫興建3棟建築，包括地上21層產業辦公大樓、18層企業安家住宅及3層商業設施，結合辦公、居住及購物等機能，提供周邊科技產業員工使用。

其中，產業辦公大樓將鎖定半導體、AI及相關供應鏈廠商，規畫A級商辦與產業作業空間，部分樓層地板載重可達每平方公尺1.5噸，以滿足設備配置及研發需求。另外，住宅部分規畫618戶，坪數約7至32坪，並設置健身、閱覽及共享生活空間。

商業布局方面，京站總經理王大政日前也指出，高雄新商場初步規畫約兩層半、1,500坪，鎖定台積電及周邊科技園區工程師、家庭客群，以餐飲及休閒服務為主要方向，預計2030年開幕。此外，基地也將透過立體人行通道連接捷運R17世運站，方便員工步行往返辦公室、住宅及商業設施。

日勝生董事長林榮顯表示，此案超過88.5億元的開發投資，是集團從都市更新、建築開發延伸至後續招商、商業服務及園區管理的重要布局，希望透過長期資產經營，參與高雄半導體產業聚落發展。

news.Title: 「演藝圈富婆」被台股血洗蒸發千萬！曾莞婷坐擁6房產：一直補到沒子彈
news.Content:
曾莞婷擔任宣導大使，13日出席國民健康署「非抹不可，健康do more」活動，自稱「曾菲特」，每天早起盯盤，近期台股大震盪，粗估千萬元蒸發，她幽默笑說，每天早上起床就有一股動力，要上班去賺錢，並且在黃仁勳婚外情影響之前，已經是萬丈深淵，被問是否抄底？她說：「一直補到沒有子彈。」

她投資有道，早已經是圈內富婆，房地產總共有6筆，其中2個是店面，「身邊沒有留很多現金，錢會愈變愈少，換成其他可能比較保值一點。」她之前有副業，已經全收攤，笑說眼不見為淨。

她在台股配置大多是AI股、個股，ETF也有買少量，雖然前陣子慘賠，但她覺得，股票就是長期佈局，持續看好未來，不會影響正常作息。她沒有買輝達股票，談黃仁勳覺得「他應該是大家崇拜對象，很棒領導人物，集智慧外貌於一身。」對於他婚外情宣布辭去執行長、總裁及董事會成員職務，她表示，「提醒大家做什麼事情之前好好思考一下。」

為響應「世界消除子宮頸癌日」，國民健康署推出「非抹不可，健康do more」宣導活動，邀請藝人曾莞婷擔任宣導大使，呼籲25歲以上女性定期子宮頸抹片檢查，並分享女性朋友一年花費5475分鐘照顧外在，而守護健康的子宮頸抹片檢查僅需短短6分鐘，鼓勵將關愛自己的心意化為實際行動，為自己的健康「多抹一點」(do more)！此外，國民健康署特別提醒65歲以上女性，勿因停經或沒有性生活而忽略篩檢，呼籲各年齡層女性響應「非抹不可」，即時行動不遲疑。

news.Title: 美股估值仍在高檔！DoubleLine創辦人：現在股價還不夠便宜、股票只配30%
news.Content:
消費者物價指數（CPI）數據升溫，引發市場擔憂。DoubleLine創辦人暨執行長Jeffrey Gundlach在2026 Yahoo財經高峰會表示，日前美股的重挫不像全面性恐慌，更像是高槓桿投資組合遭到融資追繳、被迫平倉。他認為，相關損失尚未完全浮現，目前僅建議配置30%股票，並直言要等標普500指數本益比跌破15倍，他才會重燃興趣。

暴跌仍未引發恐慌　更像高槓桿部位遭清洗

Gundlach指出，若以自高點下跌20%作為熊市標準，市場已有不少區域進入熊市或修正，但還沒有形成真正的「極度恐懼」。即使前一個交易日跌勢相當驚人，市場似乎仍未受到太大驚嚇。

他觀察，跌勢是在美股開盤後才明顯擴大，並非由海外市場率先引爆，因此推測部分高度槓桿化的投資組合在觸及特定價位後，遭到融資追繳並被迫出場。

Gundlach預期，未來幾周市場可能陸續傳出更多損失消息，甚至不排除出現破產案例。整個風險釋放過程，恐怕不會在短時間內結束。

股票部位只留30%　跌破15倍才考慮進場

基於目前的市場風險，Gundlach表示，他建議股票部位僅配置30%，並以風險較低的方式參與市場。

至於何時才會重新對股票產生興趣？他的答案相當直接：「標普500指數本益比低於15倍時，再通知我。」換言之，目前的價格仍不足以吸引他進場。

標普500指數估值一度飆42倍　未來10年實質報酬恐為負

Gundlach進一步指出，標普500指數的估值在年中一度達到42.04倍。回顧歷史，當估值處於這類高檔水準後，未來10年的實質報酬從未出現正值；即使估值高於35倍，往後獲得正實質報酬的案例也幾乎不存在。

他表示，自己著眼的是長期投資，不願意在未來實質報酬可能為負時買進股票。過去從估值約42倍的水準往後觀察10年，實質報酬通常落在負6%至負8%；若通膨回落至2%，代表名目報酬也可能陷入負值。

Gundlach強調，這不代表結果必然如此，但從歷史經驗來看，是未來10年相當可能出現的情境。他目前需要看到的不是短暫反彈，而是更便宜的股票價格。

備註：以上為受訪者個人觀點，不構成投資建議。

news.Title: 3 Warren Buffett Stocks Just Closed at Record Highs. Here's the One I'd Still Buy Now.
news.Content:
On Wednesday, Nov. 11, three stocks closely tied to Warren Buffett set records on the same day. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) closed at $355.63, Coca-Cola (NYSE:KO) at $97.57 and the Class B shares of Berkshire Hathaway (NYSE:BRKA)(NYSE:BRKB) at $588.24.

Berkshire is the link. In its latest 13F filing, covering the end of June, Apple was its largest stock holding, and Coca-Cola its fourth-largest. Both stakes were built during Buffett's decades running the company, and he remains a director after becoming chairman emeritus in September.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 16x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

Of the three, Berkshire is the one I'd still buy at its record. It's the cheapest against what it earns, and every Berkshire share comes with a piece of the other two.

Warren Buffett. Image source: Getty Images.

1. Apple's growth slowed while the stock rose

Apple stock is up around 31% this year, and Wednesday's close was its 28th record in 2026. The iPhone maker's fiscal 2026 (the year ended Sept. 26) was strong, with earnings per share up 20% to $8.98.

But growth cooled as the year ended. Apple's revenue rose 12% year over year in fiscal Q4, down from 16% in fiscal Q3 and 17% in fiscal Q2. Earnings per share climbed 14% in fiscal Q4, after a 29% jump in fiscal Q3. And the latest number included a $0.05 boost from tariff refunds, so the underlying rise was closer to 11%.

At Wednesday's close, Apple traded at around 40 times its fiscal 2026 earnings and about 38 times analysts' consensus earnings estimate for fiscal 2027. I'd say that's a hefty price for a business whose profit growth just slowed to the low double digits.

Berkshire cut its Apple holding by around 19% in the second half of 2025, to about 228 million shares, and still owned that many at the end of June. These shares would be worth about $81 billion at Wednesday's price.

I'd hold on to Apple. But at around 40 times earnings, it isn't the one I'd add to at a record.

2. Coca-Cola's price is ahead of its earnings

Coca-Cola's close on Wednesday was its 29th record this year, and the stock is up around 40% in 2026.

Coca-Cola's comparable earnings per share (its non-GAAP, or adjusted, profit measure) gained 11% in the third quarter. Management now guides for at least 11% growth this year, which would raise adjusted earnings from $3.00 per share in 2025 to at least $3.33. Sure, around 3 points of that growth come from currency.

Story Continues

At $97.57, though, the stock costs around 29 times the earnings Coca-Cola expects for 2026. That might be too high for a beverage business benefiting from exchange rates. I'd be more interested in a price near $80, or about 24 times 2026 earnings.

Berkshire completed its purchase of 400 million Coca-Cola shares in 1994 and still owned them all at the end of June. The holding would be worth around $39 billion at Wednesday's close.

"When you find a truly wonderful business, stick with it," Buffett wrote to Berkshire shareholders in early 2024, using Coca-Cola and American Express as his examples.

3. Berkshire is the cheapest of the three

Berkshire's Class B shares are up around 17% this year, well behind Apple and Coca-Cola. Wednesday's close was just its eighth record in 2026, and the stock didn't hit one between May 2025 and Oct. 20.

The stock costs less against its earnings, too. Berkshire's operating earnings (which strip out changes in the value of its stock portfolio) were around $47.2 billion during its last four quarters. That works out to around 27 times operating earnings, and about 1.6 times its Sept. 30 book value (assets minus liabilities).

Yes, third-quarter operating earnings slid around 6% year over year, as insurance underwriting earnings shrank about 43%. But even with that drop, the stock asks less of a buyer than either of the other two.

And Berkshire shareholders own the other two indirectly. Using the June 30 share counts, the Apple and Coca-Cola stakes combined would be worth around $120 billion at Wednesday's prices, or almost 10% of Berkshire's market value.

Which record would I buy?

In the end, these are three great businesses, and I don't see any of the records as a reason to sell.

Apple's growth would probably have to pick up again to justify a multiple of around 40 times earnings, and Coca-Cola is still far above the $80 or so I'd like to pay. Berkshire has the lowest price of the three.

So, Berkshire is the one I'd buy today, but I'd likely add shares gradually. As recently as Sept. 30, the stock traded slightly below its 2025 closing price, and it's climbed about 18% since.

news.Title: 輝達本周重挫逾11%沒拖垮美股！超微飆逾30% 三大類股逆勢走強
news.Content:
如果說輝達(NVDA-US)近期的問題為股市帶來什麼正面影響，那就是迫使投資人不再只盯著人工智慧(AI)投資題材的代表性企業，而是重新注意股市中的其他股票。這也是標普500指數本周迄今仍能維持強勢的原因：儘管輝達股價本周在執行長黃仁勳婚外情風暴中重挫逾11%，標普500指數仍上漲近3%。

根據FactSet數據，在標普500指數各產業類股中，工業、能源及非核心消費品類股本周表現名列前茅。

輝達影響力隨股價下滑 市場資金轉向其他晶片股

值得注意的是，輝達股價大幅下跌，並未拖累整體科技類股。這反而讓其他晶片製造商及大型雲端服務業者有了表現空間，FactSet數據顯示，標普500資訊科技類股本周迄今仍上漲3.7%。

Siebert Financial投資長Mark Malek說：「指數投資人對這場領導層風波的曝險程度，比許多人想像的更高。當一家公司的權重超過標普500指數的6%，其接班風險就會成為數百萬投資人的投資組合風險，即使這些人從未刻意買進該公司股票。」

不過，根據FactSet數據，輝達目前市值約4兆美元，若以其在標普500指數中的權重來看，可能已降至2025年5月以來最低水準。換句話說，儘管輝達仍是全球市值第二大的企業，若賣壓持續，其對標普500指數及投資人投資組合的影響力可能逐漸減弱。

超微本周大漲逾30% 投資人不再只押注單一AI題材

過去三年多來，華爾街一直擔心市場過度依賴單一股票。輝達一直是這個問題的核心，規模大到股市其他股票的走勢幾乎都難以避開它的影響。

如今在AI晶片龍頭企業爆發震撼風波之際，整體股市仍持續走高，顯示投資人似乎正在增加對單一題材以外標的的押注。FactSet數據顯示，輝達主要競爭對手之一超微(AMD-US)本周股價大漲逾30%，追蹤主要晶片製造商的費城半導體指數(SOX)同期也上漲逾11%。

Explosive Options創辦人暨首席策略師Bob Lang說：「一個人的失誤，可能成為另一個人的機會。隨著超微、Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Google及博通(Broadcom-US)等競爭對手緊追輝達，預料這些公司將在輝達處理內部問題之際搶占市占率。」

Anthropic IPO可望支撐AI行情 晶片需求仍強勁

Lang認為輝達近期股價下跌對整體AI投資題材的影響可能不大，預定下周登場的Anthropic IPO，仍可能為AI市場帶來支撐。

Edward Jones投資策略資深經濟學家James McCann則指出，投資人應避免過度集中持有科技公司股票，轉而在美國大型股及中型股之間，建立「充分分散的投資曝險」。

news.Title: 【Hot台股】黃仁勳辭任...聯發科直鎖漲停？網笑「發哥忘了有跟NV合作」 分析師：先以短線為主
news.Content:
今日社群台股最Hot議題

「發哥是忘了也有跟NV合作是嗎」「慶祝黃仁勳下台 發哥漲停」「發哥你好過分...」「發哥大利多阿 輝達跌倒 ASIC吃飽」

「發哥祈祝老黃下台」「發哥直接燈」「創意 發哥 世芯 三劍客好猛」「發哥漲停好兇」

針對網友熱議話題……專家這麼說！

HOT台股今日值班專家－大來國際投顧分析師周弘

周弘指出，聯發科最主要是反映輝達前執行長黃仁勳請辭之後，市場預期的轉單效應，畢竟聯發科最大的合作夥伴是Google ，這當然是市場的預期，在輝達後續走勢尚未明朗前，可能會認為Google的TPU有機會去取得相關廠商的訂單。

不過周弘也提醒，雖然這個概念像當時記憶體的市況，然而，聯發科跟輝達的產品屬性還是有區隔，雖然市場的解讀可以理解，但這種消息面影響還是短暫的，真正要大漲還是要基本面的加持。

周弘也指出，除了消息面的推升，作為權值股的聯發科能一舉站上重要均線月線，他也有被國安基金護盤的本身特質，當聯發科越接近4500元時，預計會震盪，因此先以短線操作為主。不過後續ASIC的走勢確實非常值得關注。

news.Title: ASIC自研晶片趨勢升溫，聯發科領軍攻漲停成台股新指標
news.Content:
【財訊快報／黃啟乙】輝達執行長黃仁勳下台所引發的市場衝擊，尤其是對AI產業的利空壓力，暫時告一段落。事實上，Google、亞馬遜及Meta原本就積極布局自研AI晶片，黃仁勳相關事件反而可能進一步加速大型科技業者發展ASIC晶片的腳步，帶動自研AI晶片產業趨勢更加明確。　　反映在台股盤面上，聯發科(2454)、創意(3443)及世芯-KY(3661)今日開盤後直接連袂跳空攻上漲停，顯示ASIC產業發展趨勢正逐漸成形。其中，聯發科與子公司達發(6526)聯手布局ASIC市場，達發股價也強勢攻上漲停，成為這波產業趨勢中的另一項重要指標。

尤其聯發科身為台灣市值第二大的企業，股價能夠跳空漲停，意味著市場對ASIC趨勢的認同與資金投入力道，可能比原先預期更強。因此，隨著台股進入下一階段，聯發科儼然成為觀察AI晶片產業發展及大盤多頭方向的重要指標，後續能否延續強勢，值得持續留意。

另一方面，大立光(3008)與玉晶光(3406)也同步攻上漲停，顯示光通訊相關題材同樣受到資金青睞，兩檔個股也成為觀察光通訊產業後續動向的領頭指標。整體而言，ASIC與光通訊兩大方向同步轉強，可能成為台股下一階段值得關注的產業主軸。

news.Title: Microsoft outage disrupts Outlook, Teams, and Copilot for users 'in any region'
news.Content:
Microsoft ( MSFT) said it was working to restore access to its workplace software after customers reported problems connecting to email and other services. Updates from the company continued into the evening as some servers that had been brought back online became unresponsive again.

On Thursday afternoon, Microsoft said users of Exchange Online, which powers Outlook email, as well as the company's Teams videoconferencing app and Copilot AI chatbot, may experience disruptions, according to a status update page . In a separate post on X, the company said users "in any region" could be affected.

Microsoft said it was rerouting connection traffic across its global infrastructure and restarting affected servers.

Around 7:05 p.m. ET, Microsoft said some servers were becoming unresponsive again as traffic returned, underscoring that the company had not yet fully stabilized the outage.

A while later, the company said it was adding capacity to handle increased traffic as more regions came back online.

news.Title: Should You Buy Alphabet Stock Now That Google Will Let Customers Run Its AI Chips in Their Own Data Centers?
news.Content:
Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL)(NASDAQ:GOOG) just gave its custom artificial intelligence (AI) chips another way to reach customers. On Monday, Nov. 9, Google Cloud announced two new versions of its tensor processing units (TPUs) -- chips Google designs to train and run AI models. And Google Cloud vice president Mark Lohmeyer told reporters that select customers will be able to install one of them, the TPU 8tx, in their own data centers.

For most of their history, the only way to use a TPU was to rent one in Google's cloud . This changed in the second quarter, when Alphabet started booking revenue on TPU systems it sold to customers running their own data centers. Google now says almost 100 customers use the chips.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Meanwhile, Alphabet shares trade near $292 as I write. Its record close was on May 13, at $402.62, which puts the stock about 28% under that peak.

Most of the revenue from those chip sales won't arrive until 2027, and Alphabet pays for the hardware first. But I think the move makes the long-term case for the stock a bit stronger.

Image source: Alphabet.

Why put TPUs in a customer's building?

The TPU 8tx is made for confidential work. Google says it's designed for regulated firms and governments running AI alongside their most sensitive data, and it protects that data even as the chip is processing it. (Usually, data needs to be unlocked in memory as a computer works on it.)

Google Cloud CEO Thomas Kurian described the appeal on Alphabet's third-quarter earnings call in late October.

"For some industries, they have data in their premise that they cannot move to a cloud, and it allows us to bring accelerated compute to where the data sits," Kurian said.

Put another way, on-site TPUs can reach customers Google's cloud can't fully serve. Some TPU customers Kurian named on the call seem to match that description, such as capital markets firms Citadel Securities and Jump Trading.

A big market, a slow start

The market these chips compete in is huge. Nvidia posted data center revenue of $89.0 billion in its fiscal second quarter alone (the period ended July 26, 2026). Even a small slice of that kind of spending could matter to Alphabet.

Showing how quickly Google's own AI business is moving, Google Cloud's third-quarter revenue more than doubled year over year to $30.7 billion, and management said TPU system sales were a meaningful contributor. The growth rate has climbed every quarter this year -- 63% in the first quarter, then 82% in the second. Cloud's backlog (contracted revenue not yet recognized, including the TPU sales deals) hit $561 billion, up from $462 billion at the end of March. And the segment's operating margin widened to 36.2% from 23.7% a year before.

Story Continues

Still, the chip sales themselves are early. Alphabet's quarterly filings say it's signed a limited number of agreements to supply TPU systems to customers who run their own infrastructure. The company expects the significant majority of the revenue from these deals to be recognized in 2027.

Alphabet pays for the chips first

Of course, selling hardware also changes how cash flows through Alphabet. It buys parts after a contract is signed but before the customer pays, so the money goes out first.

Alphabet's inventory, which consists mainly of TPU systems and Pixel devices, jumped to $13.3 billion at the end of September from $2.4 billion at the end of 2025. With that build and $51.4 billion in capital spending, free cash flow was negative $9.1 billion in the third quarter.

On the upside, Kurian said putting TPU systems in customer data centers "offsets the need for us to have to prebuild facilities to host these TPU systems." But Alphabet still expects capital spending of $195 billion to $205 billion this year, and it expects that number to grow significantly in 2027.

Does this change the case for Alphabet stock? Not overnight. But it gives Google a second way to make money on chips it already designs for itself, from business its cloud couldn't reach alone.

Alphabet stock costs around 19 times expected 2027 earnings. That's a fair price, I think, for a company whose cloud revenue just more than doubled. Free cash flow will probably stay weak for a few more quarters. Still, at this price, I'd consider buying shares.

news.Title: 黃仁勳閃辭利空出盡！ 郭明錤點名「2大廠」：將成大贏家
news.Content:
針對輝達執行長黃仁勳請辭震撼彈，天風國際證券分析師郭明錤表示，此舉對股市而言短期可能是「一次性的利空出盡」，且隨著接班不確定性浮現，Google TPU將成為最直觀的最大受益者，核心合作夥伴聯發科與博通可望成為短期市場焦點。

輝達短期利空出盡

對於黃仁勳辭職引發的市場震盪，郭明錤分析，對股市而言，短期內可能是一次性的利空出盡。由於黃仁勳目前已與輝達完全切割，接下來國會傳喚黃仁勳及後續調查，對輝達股價的影響應該會較小。至於黃仁勳離職後的動向對公司帶來的影響，在調查結果出爐前，現在就下判斷仍言之過早。

Google TPU迎轉單契機

在輝達面臨接班影響下，市場板塊也可能出現挪移。郭明錤指出，Google TPU可能有機會進一步取得客戶與供應鏈的信任，成為直觀下的最大受益者，而其核心合作廠商聯發科與博通，或許將成為短期內的市場焦點。

代理接班效應2028年浮現

針對公司內部營運與接班節奏，目前由財務長Colette Kress擔任代理執行長。郭明錤預期，後續正式執行長的交接與相應的組織改革，對輝達產品開發與整體競爭力的實質影響，最快可能自2028年開始浮現。

產能預訂與規格升級成觀察指標

過去黃仁勳的產品策略對供應鏈有著「產能預訂」與「規格升級」兩大激進影響。郭明錤認為，未來需密切關注供應鏈在擴產與新技術開發方面是否出現變化，因為這正是支撐輝達供應鏈享有高本益比的核心因素之一。

禁令難擋中國需求

針對市場擔憂的出口管制問題，郭明錤分析，輝達最終流向中國買家的AI晶片營收比重，可能高於過去對外的正式聲明，導致部分投資人擔心美國政府實施更嚴格的出口管制後，輝達的營收將顯著衰退。不過，中國終端需求並不會因出口管制而消失，即使管制加嚴，只要海外仍存在轉售管道，就算轉售價格高出數倍，中國買家仍有可能承擔溢價並輾轉取得輝達的晶片與機櫃。

（封面圖／翻攝《NVIDIA》粉專）

news.Title: 黃仁勳辭職震撼AI晶片版圖　投顧：台廠供應鏈仍無可取代
news.Content:
（中央社記者江明晏台北2026年11月13日電）AI晶片龍頭輝達執行長黃仁勳辭去執行長職務，震撼AI產業界。投顧分析，由於各大AI晶片廠商均與台廠供應鏈密切合作，台灣AI供應鏈是共同核心製造夥伴、仍無可取代；對台積電而言，AI晶片市占重分配不改變需求，但風險在美國出口管制政策是否收緊。

黃仁勳在婚外情與國安風波延燒之際，辭去輝達執行長，由財務長克瑞斯（Colette Kress）兼任臨時執行長。

由於近年黃仁勳頻繁來台，與台積電、鴻海、廣達等台灣供應鏈建立深厚革命情感，多次在公開場合強調「台灣是全球AI核心」，展現對台灣研發能量與生態系的高度重視。市場擔憂，黃仁勳請辭會撼動AI晶片版圖，並影響台廠供應鏈重組。

針對黃仁勳辭職對產業的影響，台新投顧出具報告指出，AI晶片訂單多元化趨勢可望加速，輝達競爭對手AMD、博通及自研ASIC業者有望受惠。不過，由於AI晶片廠商均與台灣供應鏈密切合作，整體供應鏈架構不致出現重大變化，台廠基本面受到的實質影響有限。

兆豐國際投顧副總經理黃國偉接受中央社記者訪問表示，黃仁勳辭去執行長對台廠「完全沒有影響」，在AI持續升級且去中化趨勢下，「台灣AI供應鏈仍無可取代」，個別廠商的變動本來就會隨著產品需求及技術演進持續調整。

至於對輝達本身的影響，黃國偉認為，黃仁勳已經將產品及技術布局推進至2028、2029年，短期內不至於受到影響，且AI產業並非仰賴單一領導人推動。不過，從長期來看，輝達的技術實力沒有問題，真正需要觀察的是未來執行效率是否下滑，若執行效率轉弱，影響恐將逐步浮現。

台積電方面，台新投顧認為，無論AI晶片由哪家業者設計，最終仍須仰賴晶圓代工及先進封裝產能，因此AI晶片市占率重新分配，不至於改變先進製程與CoWoS整體需求。真正需要留意的風險在於美國出口管制政策是否進一步收緊，市場將持續觀察美國國會是否推動更嚴格的對中晶片管制，以及輝達高階AI晶片H200對中國出貨政策是否面臨重新審查。

此外，台新投顧認為，隨著AI算力多元化發展，市場對單一供應商的依賴程度可望降低，Google、Amazon及AMD持續擴大AI布局，有助分散輝達管理層異動對產業的衝擊。由於AI晶片廠商皆與台灣供應鏈配合，台灣AI供應鏈是共同核心製造夥伴，輝達所有競爭對手均高度依賴台廠代工與零組件，訂單僅在客戶間轉移。

不過，市場也擔憂，輝達領導層變動可能影響AI伺服器規格升級速度及產品迭代節奏。若新任管理團隊調整研發與產品策略，可能使新舊世代產品交替放緩，進而限制零組件單價及規格升級帶來的成長動能，也可能影響投資市場對AI產業持續技術突破的期待。

整體而言，台新投顧認為，輝達供應鏈短期可能受到市場情緒衝擊，但純AMD及ASIC供應鏈可望受惠訂單轉移；至於與輝達合作密切的業者，包括CoreWeave、美超微（Supermicro）及技嘉等，則須留意客戶投資及訂單配置調整的風險。

news.Title: 需求增、日圓貶 石英元件廠大真空轉盈 股價飆
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-13 09:51:44 蔡承啟 發佈

車用、通訊用需求增加，加上日圓貶值，日本石英元件大廠大真空(Daishinku)今年度上半年轉虧為盈，今日股價聞訊飆漲。

根據Yahoo Finance的報價顯示，截至台北時間13日上午9點45分為止，大真空飆漲4.87%至668日圓。

大真空12日於日股盤後公布今年度上半年(2026年4-9月)財報：因車用、通訊模組用石英元件需求增加，低軌衛星需求顯現，加上受惠日圓貶值，合併營收較去年同期成長10.9%至217.19億日圓、合併營益飆增91.7%至3.44億日圓，合併純益自去年同期的虧損3.2億日圓轉為盈餘0.9億日圓。

大真空表示，4-9月設備投資(資本支出)為18.49億日圓，較去年同期(11.29億日圓)暴增63.7%

news.Title: 黃仁勳辭輝達執行長　聯發科等ASIC族群齊登漲停
news.Content:
（中央社記者張建中新竹2026年11月13日電）輝達（NVIDIA）執行長黃仁勳辭去總裁、執行長等職務，震撼全球，市場認為在輝達面臨接班不確定性下，超微（AMD）、Google的張量處理器（TPU）及特殊應用晶片（ASIC）可望受惠，聯發科、創意、世芯-KY等ASIC族群股價同步強攻漲停。

黃仁勳因涉及婚外情且有國安疑慮，辭去輝達總裁、執行長等職務，由財務長克瑞斯（Colette Kress）任臨時執行長。輝達股價震盪收跌4.3%，

市場認為在輝達面臨接班不確定下，對手超微（AMD）及Google TPU可能有機會進一步取得客戶與供應鏈信任，此外，人工智慧（AI）ASIC需求也可望升溫。超微和Google TPU合作夥伴博通（Broadcom）股價上揚逾5%。

聯發科 (2454) 同為Google TPU合作夥伴，今天股價表現強勁，開盤即跳空漲停。此外，AI ASIC族群創意 (3443) 、世芯-KY (3661) 、晶心科 (6533) 及智原 (3035) 等在市場資金湧入下，股價也都攻上漲停。

news.Title: 86檔「黃仁勳概念股」一片紅！創意聯發科5檔飆漲停 分析師：不確定性降溫
news.Content:
美股四大指數全數收低，輝達宣布黃仁勳請辭執行長後，股價下跌4.34%，台積電ADR也跌1.9%，不過超微與博通逆勢上漲逾5%，半導體股表現分歧。台股股民原先擔憂黃仁勳下台將衝擊今（13）日行情，未料台股早盤反而飆漲近1,400點，來到44,489.48點。《Yahoo股市》盤點86檔「黃仁勳概念股」，幾乎一片紅，其中創意（3443）、聯發科（2454）、世芯-KY（3661）、穎崴（6515）4檔負責晶片設計與測試介面，更在開盤即跳空鎖住漲停，散熱大廠奇鋐（3017）亦在盤中亮燈。

輝達（NVIDIA）12日晚間無預警宣布，黃仁勳辭去總裁、執行長及董事職務，即刻生效，由執行副總裁暨財務長科萊特．克雷斯（Colette Kress）擔任臨時執行長，哈維．瓊斯（Harvey C. Jones）則出任公司首位董事長。兩封員工內部信也隨之曝光，克雷斯坦言，「這是一段格外艱難的時期」，並宣布將於美國太平洋時間11月18日上午9時召開全公司會議。黃仁勳離任消息衝擊市場，輝達股價周四開盤一度下跌約14%。

不過台指期夜盤逆勢大漲548點，帶動台北股市今日開盤上漲627.88點，以43,719.75點開出，盤中漲點擴大近1,400點至44,489.48點，中小型股同步走高。

85檔「黃仁勳概念股」普遍上漲，創意（3443）、聯發科（2454）、世芯-KY（3661）3檔千金股／ASIC（客製化晶片）概念股跳空鎖漲停，盤中一度合計有超過9,000張買單排隊等買。提供高階晶片測試與探針卡的穎崴（6515）、液冷與散熱模組奇鋐（3017）2檔千金股亦同步閃紅燈。

其他包括負責後段高階封測的日月光投控（3711），核心伺服器代工（ODM） 鴻海（2317）、廣達（2382）（含旗下雲達）、緯創（3231）、緯穎（6669），PCB與ABF載板欣興（3037）、景碩（3189）、南電（8046）台光電（2383）、臻鼎-KY（4958），電源供應台達電（2308）、光寶科（2301），機器人與視覺辨識所羅門（2359）、慧友（5484）、聰泰（5474），以及工業電腦（IPC）商研華（2395）、凌華（6166）、新漢（8234）皆呈勁揚走勢。

人事底定降低不確定性＋AI長期方向不變 台股回補前日跌勢

運達投顧分析師陳石輝指出，亞股在美股開盤前，就已提前反映黃仁勳離任消息，台股前一交易日也從上漲轉為下跌，終場重挫逾千點，因此今天的反攻，可視為回補先前跌勢。他強調，「一個事件，最怕的就是不穩定」，當事件塵埃落定，市場便能重新評估影響。輝達是大型企業，本身具備一定制度與規範，短期營運應不至於出現太大改變，但長期競爭力與未來發展方向，仍須觀察。

陳石輝也強調，企業不會因黃仁勳離任就停止發展AI，政治變化也不代表產業趨勢就此中斷。他指出，AI在拜登政府時期便已發展，並非近兩年才興起；未來即使推動步調有所調整，長期方向仍未改變。若產業能以較穩定的速度前進，反而有助減少急速擴張造成的供需失衡。台灣供應鏈具備韌性，而黃仁勳離任可能加快產業影響力分散與ASIC發展的腳步，這也是相關個股率先反映的原因。

陳石輝說，無論是輝達GPU、超微（AMD）處理器，或Google自研晶片，相關產品都仰賴台積電（2330）代工。「整體供應鏈，AI都離不開台灣，不管是誰做的。」台積電的先進製程優勢，帶動周邊業者形成完整供應鏈，因此未來可能改變的是客戶與訂單分布，AI持續發展所帶來的需求仍然存在。另，鴻海（2317）、廣達（2382）等台灣廠商並非只與輝達往來，客戶也涵蓋其他科技業者，因此整體影響未必如市場先前想像般悲觀。不過，與輝達關係特別密切，或涉及特定合作承諾的個別公司，後續安排是否調整，仍有待觀察。

黃仁勳同意赴國會應詢 預計感恩節前閉門進行

據外媒報導，美國眾議院外交事務委員會主席馬斯特表示，黃仁勳已同意赴國會應詢，預計在感恩節假期前以閉門方式進行，並留下錄影與逐字紀錄。外交事務、中國問題特別及情報三個委員會先前已聯名致函，要求就輝達防範外國情報滲透的安全機制，以及黃仁勳與被指涉及中國情報活動人士的接觸作出說明；相關指控仍待調查釐清。

馮萱榕／財經特派記者，主跑財政部、電腦通路、觀光餐飲等

news.Title: 黃仁勳捲桃色間諜風暴請辭！美專家斷言無損台積電業務、輝達仍穩居AI支柱
news.Content:
即時中心／梁博超報導

AI教父黃仁勳被爆出不只一樁婚外情，甚至還涉及中國間諜；風波持續延燒，輝達董事會在週四（12日）宣布，黃仁勳請辭總裁、執行長以及董事會成員職務，財務長克瑞斯（Colette Kress）出任臨時執行長。外界憂心AI供應鏈恐受波及，美國智庫專家分析，輝達具備深厚的技術與人才底蘊，預期台積電等供應商業務不受影響；但美國政府對中國的晶片出口管制，恐將因此進一步收緊。

黃仁勳近日接連被揭露與兩名女性發展親密關係，包括遭美方認定為中國情報機構運用人員的新加坡雲端公司Megaspeed前主管黃樂（Alice Huang），以及輝達醫療保健副總裁鮑爾（Kimberly Powell），最終促使其請辭以止血。

黃仁勳請辭是維護聲譽正確決定　美智庫專家：科技業不能只靠一人

根據《中央社》報導，科技智庫「美國創新基金會」資深研究員費瑞安（Ryan Fedasiuk）在接受電訪時表示，黃仁勳的去職對輝達和美國科技業而言，「都是令人難過的一天」；但輝達跟美國科技業太過重要，「不能只依賴一個人的肩膀」。他認為，黃仁勳請辭是保護輝達聲譽的正確決定，輝達和美國半導體產業也將在黃仁勳建立的基礎上，繼續生存並蓬勃發展。

Megaspeed曾遭調查　美跨黨派恐收緊對中晶片出口

不過，由於美國曾調查Megaspeed是否協助中國取得受管制的先進AI晶片，費瑞安預期，此事件將促使美國政府進一步收緊對中晶片出口限制。他指出，目前美國共和、民主兩黨國會議員與川普（Donald Trump）政府已有強烈跨黨派共識，將徹底清查高階半導體如何透過中間商流入中國終端用戶手中。

產品線與人才庫雄厚　專家斷言「不影響台積電業務」

針對台灣市場最關心的供應鏈連動，費瑞安直言，預期這不會影響台積電或任何其他供應商的業務。他分析，雖然市場短期難免擔憂，但輝達是市值數兆美元的科技巨擘，手握強大產品線與數萬名全球頂尖工程師，這些核心競爭力不會因個人去職而在短期內消散，輝達依舊會是全球AI基礎建設的關鍵支柱。

接班人遴選估需數月

至於誰能填補黃仁勳留下的巨大空缺？美國總統川普在消息公布後，隨即發文喊話，直言只有前蘋果（Apple）CEO庫克（Tim Cook）有能力接替黃仁勳。費瑞安則評估，要找到黃仁勳的接班人並不容易，輝達董事會預計需要數週至數月的時間進行內外部遴選；但在財務長克瑞斯暫代掌舵的過渡期間，董事會仍處於穩健有利的位置，「相信輝達仍將是全球AI產業穩固的支柱」。

news.Title: 不被黃仁勳辭職影響！台積電照漲50元 市值衝近62兆元
news.Content:
全球AI晶片龍頭輝達（NVIDIA）執行長黃仁勳因接連爆出婚外情宣布請辭，消息震撼市場，拖累輝達周四股價重挫4.34%、台積電ADR同步下跌1.90%。不過，市場原本擔憂的「黑色星期五」股災並未上演，台積電台北現股（2330）今（13）日表現與ADR脫鉤，早盤開高走高觸及2,390元，上漲50元，帶動市值強勢重返61兆元大關，逼近62兆元，分析師表示，黃仁勳請辭對台積電的衝擊很小，就算之後輝達市占率因為黃仁勳不在而有所侵蝕轉向AMD，台積電還是受惠者，市場樂觀情緒延續當中，操作不用過度悲觀，在市場反彈沒有結束，仍有持續走高的機會。

輝達周四（12日）早盤股價一度重挫逾10%，隨後跌幅收斂，終場下跌4.34%，收在166.19美元。

此外，由於投資人持續評估中東地緣政治衝突前景，美股四大指數週四全數收黑。道瓊工業指數下跌189.40點，跌幅0.36%；那斯達克指數下跌0.39%；標普500指數下跌0.35%；費城半導體指數則下跌0.54%。受此拖累，台積電ADR同步走弱，下跌7.86美元或1.90%，收在405.49美元。

不過，儘管市場原本擔憂「黑色星期五」效應恐重演上週五股災，但恐慌情緒並未發酵。台積電台北現股今日表現與ADR脫鉤，早盤開高走高，盤中最高觸及2,390元、上漲50元，帶動市值強勢重返61兆元大關，引發網友疑惑「外資在等老黃下台?」、「黃仁勳下台 黑色13號星期五 結果大爆噴」、「老黃下台股市噴？」

針對黃仁勳請辭對市場的實際衝擊，資深台股分析師蔡明翰指出，今日盤面走勢可從兩個層次解讀。首先在輝達本身，人事異動對基本面的實質影響並不如想像中劇烈。輝達近年高速成長的核心動能，來自全球雲端服務業者（CSP）龐大的資本支出與AI晶片剛性需求，其GPU市佔率高達近九成，靠的是硬體規格與生態系的硬實力，而非單純仰賴黃仁勳的個人魅力；雲端大廠不會因為執行長更替就立刻改變採購策略。

因此，輝達短線營運架構不會出現劇變，真正的變數在於中長線競爭力-下一任領導人能否精準抓住AI產業的未來方向，仍需要時間觀察與驗證。

第二個層次則回到台積電本身，蔡明翰表示「受到的衝擊又更小。」台積電今日之所以能無懼ADR下跌而逆勢走高，主因在於輝達短線訂單並無變化，對台積電的營收貢獻依舊穩固。

即便把時間拉長來看，假設未來輝達新任領導人的掌舵力道不如黃仁勳強勢，導致輝達市佔率逐漸遭到侵蝕，市場份額也只會逐步流向第二大競爭對手超微（AMD）。由於超微同樣高度仰賴台積電的先進製程代工，這意味著「無論訂單在輝達或超微手中，最終都還是台積電的訂單」，整體受影響程度相當有限。隨著本周市場關注的黃仁勳請辭等重大變數陸續落地，市場樂觀情緒延續當中，操作不用過度悲觀，在市場反彈沒有結束，仍有持續走高的機會。

陳依旻／財經特派記者副組長，主跑央行、證交所、投信投顧等

news.Title: What Cisco Systems (CSCO) Said on Its Q1 Earnings Call
news.Content:
Key Points

Interested in Cisco Systems, Inc.? Here are five stocks we like better.

Cisco reported record Q1 revenue of $18.5 billion, up 24%, and adjusted EPS of $1.40, up 40%. Both exceeded guidance, prompting the company to raise its fiscal 2027 revenue outlook to $74.8 billion–$75.8 billion and adjusted EPS outlook to $5.47–$5.53.

Cisco lifted its fiscal 2027 hyperscaler AI infrastructure revenue forecast to $9 billion from $7.5 billion , citing customer demand and improved visibility. It reported 18 AI design wins over five quarters and described networking demand as part of an early-stage, multiyear cycle.

Product orders rose 21%, while networking revenue grew 43%; however, adjusted gross margin declined to 65.6% amid a higher hardware mix and elevated memory costs. Cisco expects full-year adjusted gross margin just below 65% and returned $3.7 billion to shareholders in Q1.

5 Beaten-Down Growth Stocks Trading Like Value Plays as Cash Chases Mega-Caps

Cisco Systems (NASDAQ:CSCO) raised its fiscal 2027 revenue and earnings outlook after reporting record first-quarter sales, as demand for networking equipment and artificial intelligence infrastructure drove its strongest revenue and earnings growth rates in more than 15 years.

Revenue rose 24% year over year to $18.5 billion, while adjusted earnings per share increased 40% to $1.40. Both figures exceeded the high end of the company's guidance, CFO Mark Patterson said on the earnings call.

→ D-Wave Quantum Has Long-Term Potential, But Is Now the Time to Buy?

The AI Buildout Is Only 15% Complete—Here Is Where the Next Dollar Actually Goes

Cisco now expects fiscal 2027 revenue of $74.8 billion to $75.8 billion and adjusted earnings of $5.47 to $5.53 per share. Patterson said the company raised its revenue outlook by $2.5 billion, including $1.5 billion from hyperscale customers and $1 billion from the rest of the business.

AI Infrastructure Forecast Rises

Cisco increased its fiscal 2027 forecast for AI infrastructure revenue from hyperscalers to $9 billion from $7.5 billion, more than double the prior year's level. Chair and CEO Chuck Robbins attributed the increase to continued customer demand and greater visibility into the year.

Robbins said Cisco secured three new AI design wins in the first quarter: two for P200-powered systems used to connect data centers and extend workloads across them, and one for 1.6-terabit optics in a scale-out application. The $9 billion forecast includes hyperscalers but excludes neocloud customers, Robbins said. He characterized Cisco's neocloud exposure as relatively immaterial and said the company has been conservative about credit risk.

Robbins described the opportunity as an early-stage, multiyear networking cycle. He cited hyperscale deployments, campus network upgrades, sovereign infrastructure and enterprise investment in hybrid data centers among the drivers supporting his outlook.

Campus networking product orders rose 14% year over year. Robbins said only 9% of the switching Cisco sold in the quarter came from its new portfolio, which he cited as evidence that the refresh cycle remains in its early stages.

Orders and Networking Revenue Grow

Total product orders increased 21% from a year earlier, including 14% growth excluding hyperscalers. Networking product orders rose 28%, marking the ninth consecutive quarter of double-digit growth.

Growth extended across customer groups: service provider and cloud orders rose 47%, enterprise orders increased 15%, and public sector orders grew 13%. Geographically, orders rose 18% in the Americas, 12% in Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and 57% in Asia Pacific, Japan and China.

Networking revenue increased 43%, led by triple-digit growth in AI infrastructure and double-digit growth in data center switching and campus networking. Security revenue rose 7%, while collaboration revenue increased 8%. Services revenue edged up 1% to $3.9 billion.

Adjusted gross margin fell 250 basis points year over year to 65.6%, as hardware revenue grew faster than software and services. First-quarter operating cash flow rose 36% to $4.4 billion. Cisco returned $3.7 billion to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases, with $6.1 billion remaining under its repurchase program.
